EA-11213.name: Exp_HullTrend
EA-11213.summary: This EA trades based on the HullTrend custom indicator, which uses a Hull Moving Average to determine trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA includes money management options and separate controls for opening and closing positions on each side.
EA-11213.summary_zh: 该EA基于HullTrend自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用Hull移动平均线判断趋势方向。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损止盈。EA包含资金管理选项以及对多空双方开仓和平仓的独立控制。
EA-11213.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Hull移动平均线的趋势跟踪，Hull MA通过加权移动平均的平方根周期来减少滞后性，从而更灵敏地捕捉趋势转折。入场条件为：当指标线Ind上穿信号线Sign时触发买入信号（BUY_Open），当Ind下穿Sign时触发卖出信号（SELL_Open），交叉确认需要两个连续K线的指标关系变化。出场条件包括：当趋势反转信号出现时平仓（BUY_Close/SELL_Close），以及固定的止损（StopLoss_=1000点）和止盈（TakeProfit_=2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制仓位比例，MMMode枚举支持自由保证金、余额、亏损保证金、亏损余额和固定手数五种模式。资金管理集成了TradeAlgorithms.mqh库的标准化函数，提供多种资金管理计算方式。EA在每根新K线开盘时检测信号，避免逐tick重复交易，使用IsNewBar机制进行信号刷新。
EA-11213.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Hull Moving Average trend following, where Hull MA reduces lag by using a square-root period of weighted moving averages, making it more responsive to trend reversals. Entry conditions are: a buy signal (BUY_Open) triggers when the indicator line Ind crosses above the signal line Sign, and a sell signal (SELL_Open) triggers when Ind crosses below Sign, requiring a relationship change between two consecutive bars for crossover confirmation. Exit conditions include: closing positions on trend reversal signals (BUY_Close/SELL_Close), plus fixed stop loss (StopLoss_=1000 points) and take profit (TakeProfit_=2000 points). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with the MMMode enumeration supporting five modes: free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss balance, and fixed lot. Money management integrates the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library's standardized functions providing multiple capital allocation calculation methods. The EA detects signals only on new bar openings to avoid per-tick repeated trading, using the IsNewBar mechanism for signal refresh.

EA-11214.name: Exp_TSI_MACD
EA-11214.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom TSI_MACD indicator, which combines True Strength Index smoothing with MACD-style signal line logic. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position sizing, stop loss, and take profit. Trade entry and exit are controlled by separate boolean flags, allowing flexible signal filtering.
EA-11214.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义TSI_MACD指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标结合了真实强度指数(TSI)平滑与MACD式信号线逻辑。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理、止损和止盈。入场和出场由独立的布尔开关控制，允许灵活的信号过滤。
EA-11214.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于TSI_MACD指标的动量交叉系统。TSI（True Strength Index）是一种双重平滑动量指标，通过对价格动量进行两次平滑处理来减少噪音，然后用MACD式的信号线交叉产生交易信号。入场条件为：指标线Ind上穿信号线Sign时开多仓，Ind下穿Sign时开空仓，交叉判断通过比较相邻两根K线的Ind和Sign值大小关系实现。出场条件包括：反向交叉信号触发平仓（多仓在Ind下穿Sign时平仓，空仓在Ind上穿Sign时平仓），以及固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit止盈止损。仓位管理支持多种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净损保证金比例、按净损余额比例，以及固定手数模式。资金管理参数MM控制仓位比例，默认0.1即10%。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓。
EA-11214.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a momentum crossover system based on the TSI_MACD indicator. TSI (True Strength Index) is a double-smoothed momentum indicator that reduces noise by applying two rounds of smoothing to price momentum, then generates trading signals using MACD-style signal line crossovers. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator line Ind crosses above the signal line Sign, and a sell position opens when Ind crosses below Sign, with crossover detection implemented by comparing Ind and Sign values across two consecutive bars. Exit conditions include: reverse crossover signals trigger position closing (long positions close when Ind crosses below Sign, short positions close when Ind crosses above Sign), along with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of net-loss free margin, percentage of net-loss balance, and fixed lot mode. The money management parameter MM controls the position ratio, defaulting to 0.1 (10%). The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries.

EA-11216.name: Exp_TSI_CCI
EA-11216.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the TSI_CCI custom indicator, which combines True Strength Index smoothing with CCI momentum. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing and money management options.
EA-11216.summary_zh: 该EA基于TSI_CCI自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标结合了真实强度指数平滑与CCI动量。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并支持可配置的平仓和资金管理选项。
EA-11216.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于TSI_CCI指标的双重平滑CCI动量交叉信号。入场条件为：当指标线(Ind)上穿信号线(Sign)时触发买入开仓，当指标线下穿信号线时触发卖出开仓，同时要求前一根K线上指标线已处于信号线另一侧以确保交叉确认。出场条件包括：指标线上穿信号线时平卖仓，下穿信号线时平买仓，同时可配置固定点数的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持五种资金管理模式(自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额、固定手数)。资金管理采用MarginMode枚举选择模式，默认为固定手数(LOT)模式，MM参数0.1代表10%的资金使用比例。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复入场，同时通过Recount标志处理指标数据加载失败的重试逻辑。
EA-11216.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on crossover signals from the TSI_CCI indicator, which applies triple smoothed moving average processing to CCI momentum values. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator line (Ind) crosses above the signal line (Sign) with confirmation that the previous bar had Ind below Sign, and vice versa for sell signals. Exit conditions: sell positions close when the indicator crosses above the signal line, buy positions close on the opposite crossover, supplemented by configurable Stop Loss (1000 points) and Take Profit (2000 points). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with five money management modes: Free Margin, Balance, Loss Free Margin, Loss Balance, and Fixed Lot, defaulting to Fixed Lot mode. The money management allows risk allocation of 10% (MM=0.1) by default across the selected margin mode. The strategy uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and employs a Recount flag to handle indicator data loading failures with automatic retry logic.

EA-11246.name: Exp_TSI_WPR
EA-11246.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from a custom TSI_WPR indicator, which combines the True Strength Index with Williams' Percent Range. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above its signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable money management and position closing options.
EA-11246.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义TSI_WPR指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标结合了真实强度指数和威廉百分比范围。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，支持可配置的资金管理和平仓选项。
EA-11246.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于TSI_WPR指标的动量交叉，该指标将WPR（威廉百分比范围）通过多次平滑算法处理后生成主线和信号线。入场条件为：当主线大于信号线且前一周期主线小于等于信号线时触发买入信号，反之触发卖出信号。出场条件通过指标交叉反向信号平仓，同时设有固定的StopLoss和TakeProfit。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金或固定手数的资金管理方式。该策略使用多周期框架（默认H4），并允许用户选择多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX等）来调整指标灵敏度。信号检测仅在NewBar时触发，避免同一K线内重复交易，但缺少点差过滤和加仓限制。
EA-11246.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum crossover of the TSI_WPR indicator, which processes WPR (Williams' Percent Range) through multiple smoothing algorithms to generate a main line and a signal line. Entry conditions trigger a buy signal when the main line crosses above the signal line (Ind[1]>Sign[1] and Ind[0]<=Sign[0]), and a sell signal on the reverse crossover. Exit conditions use reverse crossover signals for closing positions, along with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin, or fixed lot size. The strategy operates on a multi-timeframe basis (default H4) and allows selection of various smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) to adjust indicator sensitivity. Signal detection only triggers on new bars via IsNewBar() to prevent repeated trades within the same candle, but lacks spread filtering and position accumulation limits.

EA-11247.name: Exp_Karpenko
EA-11247.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom 'Karpenko' indicator, which uses a 144-period MA with historical analysis. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position management is handled through the TradeAlgorithms library with multiple margin mode options.
EA-11247.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'Karpenko'指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标使用144周期均线和历史数据分析。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损止盈水平。仓位管理通过TradeAlgorithms库实现，支持多种保证金模式。
EA-11247.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于Karpenko自定义指标的趋势跟踪策略，核心逻辑是指标线与信号线的交叉判断。入场条件：当指标线从下方穿越信号线向上时触发买入信号（BUY_Open），当指标线从上方穿越信号线向下时触发卖出信号（SELL_Open），交叉判断需要前一根K线的指标关系满足条件且当前K线确认穿越。出场条件包括止损和止盈（默认SL=1000点，TP=2000点），同时支持反向信号平仓——当出现卖出信号时自动平掉多头仓位，反之亦然。仓位管理方面，EA支持五种保证金模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除浮亏后的自由保证金比例、扣除浮亏后的余额比例以及固定手数模式。默认使用固定手数0.1手。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，并通过Recount标志在数据不足时重新计算。策略运行在H4周期上，使用144周期MA作为基础参数，历史回溯500根K线。
EA-11247.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy based on the custom Karpenko indicator, with core logic centered on crossover detection between the indicator line and signal line. Entry conditions: a buy signal (BUY_Open) is triggered when the indicator line crosses above the signal line from below, while a sell signal (SELL_Open) fires when the indicator line crosses below the signal line from above; crossover confirmation requires the previous bar's indicator relationship to satisfy the condition and the current bar to confirm the crossover. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), plus opposite-signal closing where a sell signal automatically closes long positions and vice versa. Position sizing supports five margin modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size, defaulting to 0.1 lots fixed. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries, and employs a Recount flag to trigger recalculation when insufficient data is available. The strategy operates on the H4 timeframe using a 144-period MA as the base parameter with 500 bars of historical lookback.

EA-11254.name: Exp_SlopeDirectionLine
EA-11254.summary: This EA trades based on the SlopeDirectionLine custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0). It uses a double-smoothing approach with configurable smoothing methods and manages both entry and exit signals independently with separate toggle switches.
EA-11254.summary_zh: 该EA基于SlopeDirectionLine自定义指标进行交易，当指标信号为上升趋势（值=2）时开多仓，当信号为下降趋势（值=0）时开空仓。它采用双平滑方法，支持配置平滑算法，并独立管理入场和出场信号。
EA-11254.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于SlopeDirectionLine指标的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件：当指标缓冲区1的值从非2变为2时开多仓，从非0变为0时开空仓，这表示趋势方向发生转变。出场条件：当上升趋势信号出现时平空仓，当下降趋势信号出现时平多仓，实现了趋势反转时自动平仓。仓位管理方面，支持多种保证金模式（MMMode），包括基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。指标本身使用两层平滑算法，第一层对价格进行主要平滑（如LWMA），第二层对第一层结果再平滑（如SMA），从而产生更平滑的趋势判断线。
EA-11254.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a trend-following system based on the SlopeDirectionLine indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 1 value changes from non-2 to 2 (uptrend onset), and a sell position opens when it changes from non-0 to 0 (downtrend onset), signaling trend direction changes. Exit conditions: existing sell positions close when an uptrend signal appears, and existing buy positions close when a downtrend signal appears, implementing automatic position closure on trend reversal. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes (MMMode) including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1, representing the risk fraction per trade. The indicator itself employs a dual-smoothing algorithm where the first layer applies primary smoothing to price data (e.g., LWMA) and the second layer further smooths the result (e.g., SMA), producing a smoother trend determination line.

EA-11256.name: Exp_TSI_DeMarker
EA-11256.summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the TSI_DeMarker custom indicator, which combines DeMarker oscillator values with True Strength Index (TSI) smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing and money management options.
EA-11256.summary_zh: 该EA基于TSI_DeMarker自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标将DeMarker振荡器与真实强度指数(TSI)平滑算法相结合。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并提供可配置的平仓和资金管理选项。
EA-11256.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于TSI_DeMarker指标的主线与信号线交叉，本质上是一个动量反转策略。入场条件为：当指标线处于信号线上方且前一周期指标线从下方穿越信号线时，触发买入信号；反之当指标线处于信号线下方且从上方穿越时，触发卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向交叉信号触发的平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用多种模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的保证金比例以及固定手数四种方式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1即10%的资金分配。策略使用了多重平滑算法（XMA）对DeMarker值进行处理，通过三个不同长度的平滑周期生成主线和信号线，从而过滤噪声并捕捉趋势动量变化。
EA-11256.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of the TSI_DeMarker indicator's main line and signal line, essentially a momentum reversal strategy. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator line is above the signal line and the previous bar's indicator line crossed from below the signal line; conversely, a sell signal triggers when the indicator line is below and crosses from above. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus closing positions on reverse crossover signals when the corresponding close flags are enabled. Position sizing supports four modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter defaulting to 0.1 (10% capital allocation). The strategy employs multiple smoothing algorithms (XMA) on DeMarker values, using three different smoothing lengths to generate the main and signal lines, filtering noise and capturing momentum shifts.

EA-1129.name: Exp_MaRsi-Trigger
EA-1129.summary: This EA uses a dual RSI and dual MA crossover system to identify trend direction changes and generate trading signals. It compares a short-period RSI against a long-period RSI and a short-period MA against a long-period MA, combining both signals to confirm trend shifts. Trades are opened only on trend reversals where both indicator pairs agree on the new direction.
EA-1129.summary_zh: 该EA使用双RSI和双MA交叉系统来识别趋势方向变化并生成交易信号。它将短期RSI与长期RSI比较、短期MA与长期MA比较，结合两个信号确认趋势转变。仅在趋势反转且两组指标一致指向新方向时才开仓。
EA-1129.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双指标确认的趋势跟踪系统，通过短期RSI与长期RSI的相对位置以及短期MA与长期MA的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当信号柱上短期MA大于长期MA且短期RSI大于长期RSI时，趋势得分Trend为正（最大+2），若上一趋势方向为负则触发买入开仓；反之，当Trend为负且上一趋势为正时触发卖出开仓。出场条件依赖反向信号：当趋势反转为空头时平多头仓位，趋势反转为多头时平空头仓位，同时设有固定的止损和止盈点数。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示存款比例。资金管理采用百分比或固定手数模式，止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险回报比为1:2。策略还使用IsNewBar机制确保仅在新区块时计算信号，避免重复交易。
EA-1129.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual-indicator-confirmed trend following system that determines trend direction by comparing the relative positions of short-period vs long-period RSI and short-period vs long-period MA. Entry conditions: on the signal bar, if the short MA is above the long MA and the short RSI is above the long RSI, the Trend score is positive (max +2); if the previous trend was negative, a buy entry is triggered. Conversely, when Trend is negative and the previous trend was positive, a sell entry is triggered. Exit conditions rely on reversal signals: long positions are closed when the trend turns bearish, and short positions are closed when the trend turns bullish, with fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management uses percentage or fixed lot mode with a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The strategy also uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are only calculated on new bars, preventing repeated trades within the same bar.

EA-11345.name: Exp_MaByMa
EA-11345.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from a custom 'MaByMa' indicator, which smooths one moving average by another. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-11345.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义'MaByMa'指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标用一条均线平滑另一条均线。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，支持可配置的资金管理和止损止盈设置。
EA-11345.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是双重平滑均线交叉系统，使用MaByMa指标将一条均线再进行一次平滑处理，从而减少假信号。入场条件为：当指标线Ind上穿信号线Sign时产生买入信号，下穿时产生卖出信号，仅在信号发生交叉时才触发新交易。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈，同时也支持反向信号平仓——即买入信号时平卖仓，卖出信号时平买仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比、基于亏损后余额百分比和基于亏损后可用保证金百分比。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。策略使用SignalBar参数决定在哪根K线检测信号，默认为1即前一根已收盘K线，这有助于避免未收盘K线的信号闪烁问题。
EA-11345.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a dual-smoothed moving average crossover system using the MaByMa indicator, which applies a second smoothing to one moving average to reduce false signals. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator line Ind crosses above the signal line Sign, and a sell signal on the opposite crossover, with trades only triggered on actual crossovers. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points, and also support signal-based exits where a buy signal closes sell positions and vice versa. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and loss-adjusted free margin percentage. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1, representing the risk fraction. The strategy uses the SignalBar parameter to determine which bar to check for signals, defaulting to 1 (the last closed bar), which helps avoid signal flickering from unclosed bars.

EA-11349.name: YURAZ_CLOSEPRC_V3_1
EA-11349.summary: This EA trades based on close price analysis, comparing the current bar's close price relative to previous bars to detect momentum shifts. It opens positions when the close price confirms a directional momentum move and manages exits through take profit and stop loss levels. The strategy is a simple price-action momentum system without complex indicator dependencies.
EA-11349.summary_zh: 该EA基于收盘价分析进行交易，通过比较当前K线收盘价与前期K线的关系来检测动量变化。当收盘价确认方向性动量移动时开仓，并通过止盈止损水平管理出场。该策略是一个简单的价格行为动量系统，不依赖复杂指标。
EA-11349.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于收盘价的动量判断，通过分析当前K线收盘价相对于前若干根K线收盘价的位置关系来决定交易方向。入场条件为当收盘价连续高于或低于前期收盘价时，确认动量方向并顺势开仓。出场条件依赖固定的止盈止损设置，没有追踪止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例控制，没有根据波动率或账户净值来计算最优仓位。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但缺乏对市场状态（趋势/震荡）的过滤机制，容易在震荡行情中产生频繁的虚假信号和亏损交易。
EA-11349.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on close price momentum detection, analyzing the relationship between the current bar's close price and previous bars' close prices to determine trading direction. Entry conditions trigger when the close price consecutively stays above or below prior close prices, confirming momentum direction and opening positions accordingly. Exit conditions rely on fixed take profit and stop loss levels without trailing stops or dynamic exit mechanisms. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or balance. Money management lacks risk-proportion control, with no calculation of optimal position size based on volatility or account net equity. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, but it lacks a market state filter (trend vs range), which can lead to frequent false signals and losing trades during choppy conditions.

EA-1135.name: Combo_Right
EA-1135.summary: This EA combines a basic CCI-based trading signal with up to three perceptron neural networks (sale, buying, and general) to generate buy/sell signals. The perceptrons use weighted price differences over configurable historical periods, and the operating mode (pass parameter) selects which signal source drives trade decisions. Positions are opened with fixed lot sizes and configurable stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-1135.summary_zh: 该EA将基于CCI指标的基础交易信号与最多三个感知器神经网络（卖出、买入和通用）相结合来生成买卖信号。感知器使用可配置历史周期上的加权价格差值，运行模式（pass参数）选择哪个信号源驱动交易决策。持仓以固定手数和可配置的止损/止盈水平开仓。
EA-1135.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA融合了传统CCI指标信号与感知器神经网络，构成一个混合交易系统。入场条件：基础系统以CCI值作为信号（正值为买入，负值为卖出）；感知器系统通过计算多个时间偏移的收盘价差值的加权和来输出信号，卖出感知器输出负值触发卖出，买入感知器输出正值触发买入，通用感知器决定最终方向优先级。出场条件：完全依赖固定点数的止损和止盈来平仓，没有动态追踪止损或其他出场机制。仓位管理：使用固定手数（lots参数），没有根据账户余额或风险动态调整仓位大小的机制。资金管理：三套感知器各自有独立的止损止盈参数（sl2/tp2, sl3/tp3），基础系统也有独立的sl1/tp1，但缺乏整体资金管理框架。运行模式通过pass参数控制：1=仅基础系统，2=仅卖出感知器，3=仅买入感知器，4=所有感知器联合决策。
EA-1135.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA merges a traditional CCI indicator signal with perceptron neural networks, forming a hybrid trading system. Entry conditions: The basic system uses the CCI value as a signal (positive for buy, negative for sell); the perceptron system computes a weighted sum of close price differences across multiple time offsets, where the sale perceptron negative output triggers sells, the buying perceptron positive output triggers buys, and the general perceptron determines final direction priority. Exit conditions: Relies entirely on fixed-point stop-loss and take-profit for position closure, with no trailing stop or other dynamic exit mechanisms. Position sizing: Uses a fixed lot size (lots parameter) with no dynamic sizing based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management: Three perceptron sets each have independent SL/TP parameters (sl2/tp2, sl3/tp3), and the basic system has sl1/tp1, but there is no overall money management framework. Operating mode is controlled via the pass parameter: 1=basic system only, 2=sale perceptron only, 3=buying perceptron only, 4=all perceptrons combined for joint decision-making.

EA-11350.name: chtrailing
EA-11350.summary: This EA is a channel-based trailing stop utility that manages existing positions by moving stop losses according to a highest-high/lowest-low channel with an offset. It also implements a 'noose' trailing mechanism that mirrors the take-profit distance to set a symmetric stop loss, and optionally deletes pending orders when a position is opened.
EA-11350.summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于通道的移动止损工具，根据最高价/最低价通道加减偏移来管理已有持仓的止损。它还实现了'绞索'追踪机制，将止盈距离镜像对称设置为止损，并在持仓建立时可选删除挂单。
EA-11350.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA不是一个独立开仓的交易策略，而是一个止损管理工具。它基于指定周期内的最高价和最低价构建通道，将通道上轨加偏移作为空头止损，通道下轨减偏移作为多头止损。入场条件：EA本身不执行入场操作，仅管理已有持仓的止损。出场条件：当通道下轨上移超过当前多头止损时，上移止损；当通道上轨下移低于当前空头止损时，下移止损；'绞索'机制则将止损设在以止盈为镜像的对称位置，随价格推进不断收紧。仓位管理：EA不涉及仓位大小设置，仅修改止损和保留原止盈。资金管理：无资金管理逻辑，不计算风险比例或动态调整仓位。额外功能包括在新仓位成交时自动删除同品种挂单。
EA-11350.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a trailing stop management utility rather than an independent entry strategy. It constructs a channel from the highest high and lowest low over a user-defined lookback period, adding a point offset to form upper and lower trailing levels. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not open positions — it only manages stop losses on existing ones. Exit conditions for long positions trigger when the channel lower bound moves above the current stop loss, tightening the stop; for short positions, when the channel upper bound moves below the current stop loss. The 'noose' trailing mechanism mirrors the take-profit distance from the current price to set a symmetric stop loss, progressively locking in profit as price moves favorably. Position sizing and money management are entirely absent — the EA only modifies stop loss and preserves the existing take profit. An auxiliary feature deletes all pending orders for the symbol when a deal is added and a position exists.

EA-1136.name: Eugene
EA-1136.summary: This EA trades based on inside bar (insider) candlestick patterns combined with zigzag breakout confirmation. It enters buy positions when price breaks above the prior bar's high with a confirmed bullish setup, and sells on breaks below the prior low with bearish confirmation. Position management includes optional stop loss/take profit and a one-trade-per-bar filter using global variables.
EA-1136.summary_zh: 该EA基于内包线（Insider Bar）K线形态结合Zigzag突破确认进行交易。当价格突破前一根K线高点且看涨确认条件满足时开多仓，突破低点且看跌确认条件满足时开空仓。仓位管理包含可选的止损止盈，并使用全局变量实现每根K线仅交易一次的过滤机制。
EA-1136.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于内包线（Inside Bar）形态识别，即当前K线完全被前一根K线包含的形态。入场条件方面，做多需要价格突破前高（Buy_signal）且满足确认条件（Confirm_buy），确认条件包括当前低价触及Zig_level_buy或时间超过8点，同时排除黑鸟形态和白色内包线；做空反之。出场条件是当出现反向信号时平仓，例如持多仓时出现看跌确认信号且价格跌破前高。仓位管理使用固定手数（Lots参数），没有动态仓位或资金管理逻辑。止损止盈为可选参数，以点数计算并根据买卖方向分别基于Ask/Bid价格设置。策略还包含信号反转功能（InvertSignals），可将买卖信号互换使用。时间过滤方面，8点以后自动确认信号有效，作为时间兜底机制。
EA-1136.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on Inside Bar candlestick pattern recognition, where the current bar is completely contained within the previous bar's range. For entry, a buy requires price breaking above the prior high (Buy_signal) with confirmation (Confirm_buy), which includes the current low touching Zig_level_buy or time past 8:00, while excluding Black_bird and White_insider patterns; sell conditions are symmetrical. Exit conditions trigger when a reverse signal appears - for example, a long position closes when a bearish confirmation signal occurs and price falls below the prior bar's high. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (Lots parameter) with no dynamic position or money management logic. Stop loss and take profit are optional parameters, calculated in points based on Ask/Bid prices depending on trade direction. The strategy includes a signal inversion feature (InvertSignals) that swaps buy and sell signals. A time filter automatically confirms signals as valid after hour 8, serving as a fallback confirmation mechanism.

EA-11372.name: Exp_ExchangePrice
EA-11372.summary: This EA trades based on the custom ExchangePrice indicator, generating buy signals when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell signals when it crosses below. It uses a new-bar check to avoid repeated entries on the same bar, and manages positions with configurable Stop Loss, Take Profit, and multiple money management modes including lot-based and margin-based sizing.
EA-11372.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义ExchangePrice指标进行交易，当指标线上穿信号线时生成买入信号，下穿时生成卖出信号。EA使用新K线检查避免同一根K线上重复入场，并通过可配置的止损、止盈以及多种资金管理模式（包括固定手数和基于保证金的仓位计算）来管理持仓。
EA-11372.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于自定义ExchangePrice指标的两条线（主线Ind和信号线Sign）的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当Ind[1]>Sign[1]（上一根K线主线在信号线上方）且Ind[0]<=Sign[0]（再上一根K线主线在信号线下方或相等）时，确认上升趋势启动，触发买入开仓；反之当Ind[1]<Sign[1]且Ind[0]>=Sign[0]时确认下降趋势启动，触发卖出开仓。出场条件包括：做多时若出现下降趋势信号则平多仓，做空时若出现上升趋势信号则平空仓，同时每笔交易都设有StopLoss和TakeProfit进行风控。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于净亏损后的可用保证金、基于净亏损后的余额，以及固定手数模式。EA通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时使用Recount标志在CopyBuffer失败时重新获取数据。
EA-11372.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the crossover of two lines (main line Ind and signal line Sign) from the custom ExchangePrice indicator to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: when Ind[1]>Sign[1] (main line above signal line on the previous bar) and Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (main line below or equal on the bar before that), an uptrend is confirmed and a buy position is opened; conversely, when Ind[1]<Sign[1] and Ind[0]>=Sign[0], a downtrend is confirmed and a sell position is opened. Exit conditions include: closing long positions when a downtrend signal appears, closing short positions when an uptrend signal appears, with StopLoss and TakeProfit applied to every trade for risk control. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, based on balance, based on free margin after losses, based on balance after losses, and fixed lot size. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar cycle, avoiding repeated trades, and employs a Recount flag to re-fetch data when CopyBuffer fails.

EA-114.name: expHA_ (Heiken_Ashi based EA)
EA-114.summary: This EA trades based on Heiken Ashi candlestick direction, opening positions when a consistent three-bar trend acceleration pattern is detected. It uses a custom Heiken Ashi indicator to derive open and close buffer values, comparing successive differences to confirm strengthening momentum before entering. Positions are managed with a fixed lot size and a stop loss derived from the current Heiken Ashi open price, while opposing signals trigger position reversal.
EA-114.summary_zh: 该EA基于平滑蜡烛图(Heiken Ashi)方向进行交易，当检测到连续三根蜡烛趋势加速形态时开仓。它使用自定义平滑蜡烛指标获取开盘价和收盘价缓冲区，通过比较连续差值确认动量增强后才入场。仓位采用固定手数管理，止损取自当前平滑蜡烛开盘价，反向信号触发平仓反转。
EA-114.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于平滑蜡烛图(Heiken Ashi)的趋势跟踪，通过分析连续三根HA蜡烛的开盘价递进关系和收盘价与开盘价的相对位置来判断趋势方向和强度。入场条件为多头时要求连续三根HA收盘价均高于对应开盘价(e>a, f>b, g>c)，且开盘价差值逐根放大(w>x>y>0)，表明上升趋势加速；空头反之。出场条件包括反向信号出现时平仓反转，以及止损设在最新HA开盘价处。仓位管理采用固定手数0.1手，并通过P参数限制同方向最大持仓数量(默认3)。资金管理方面仅在保证金水平低于120%时禁止开仓，缺乏独立的风险控制机制如最大回撤限制或动态仓位调整。
EA-114.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on Heiken Ashi smoothed candlesticks, analyzing the progressive relationship of open prices across three consecutive HA bars and the relative position of close versus open prices to determine both trend direction and strength. Entry conditions for a long require three consecutive HA closes above their respective opens (e>a, f>b, g>c), with open price differences increasing bar over bar (w>x>y>0), signaling accelerating uptrend momentum; short conditions are the mirror opposite. Exit conditions include position reversal on opposing signals and a stop loss set at the latest HA open price. Position sizing uses a fixed lot of 0.1, with the P parameter capping the maximum number of same-direction positions (default 3). Money management only blocks new entries when the margin level falls below 120%, lacking independent risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits or dynamic position sizing.

EA-1140.name: Exp_CenterOfGravity
EA-1140.summary: This EA trades based on the Center of Gravity indicator, which is an oscillator-type indicator that identifies overbought and oversold conditions. It opens buy positions when the signal line crosses upward and sell positions when it crosses downward, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA uses a custom CenterOfGravity indicator handle and processes signals on a specified timeframe with new bar detection.
EA-1140.summary_zh: 该EA基于重心指标(CenterOfGravity)进行交易，这是一种振荡类指标，用于识别超买和超卖状态。当信号线上穿时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，配有可配置的止损止盈水平。EA使用自定义重心指标句柄，在指定时间周期上通过新K线检测来处理交易信号。
EA-1140.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于CenterOfGravity指标，这是一种均值回归型振荡器，通过计算价格的重心来判断市场的超买超卖状态。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值从2变为1时产生买入信号（信号线上穿上行线），当值从1变为2时产生卖出信号（信号线下穿）。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发平仓以及预设的止损止盈点位。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于存款比例的资金管理方式，通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示存款占比。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓。同时提供了买入/卖出开关以及平仓权限开关，允许灵活控制交易方向和出场行为。
EA-1140.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Center of Gravity indicator, a mean reversion oscillator that identifies overbought and oversold market conditions by calculating the center of gravity of price. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when buffer 1 value transitions from 2 to 1 (signal line crossing upward), and a sell signal is generated when the value transitions from 1 to 2 (signal line crossing downward). Exit conditions rely on reverse signal triggers for position closure plus configurable stop loss and take profit levels in points. Position sizing uses either fixed lot size or deposit-percentage-based money management controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lots and positive values represent deposit share. The EA employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries. It also provides buy/sell permission switches and close position toggles for flexible control over trading direction and exit behavior.

EA-11407.name: Exp_BnB
EA-11407.summary: This EA trades based on the BnB (Bulls and Bears) custom indicator, using a smoothed momentum approach to detect trend direction changes. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable money management and position closing logic.
EA-11407.summary_zh: 该EA基于BnB（多空力量）自定义指标进行交易，使用平滑动量方法检测趋势方向变化。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并配有可配置的资金管理和仓位关闭逻辑。
EA-11407.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于BnB自定义指标的多空力量动量判断，BnB指标通过可配置的平滑算法（支持SMA、EMA、JJMA、T3等多种方法）对成交量加权的多空力量进行平滑处理。入场条件为：当指标线Ind高于信号线Sign时为多头趋势，若前一根K线Ind下穿Sign则触发买入信号；反之当Ind低于Sign时为空头趋势，若前一根K线Ind上穿Sign则触发卖出信号。出场条件通过趋势反转自动触发平仓——多头趋势中触发卖出平仓，空头趋势中触发买入平仓，同时配合StopLoss和TakeProfit参数进行止损止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、余额、扣除亏损后可用保证金、扣除亏损后余额以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算模式。策略默认使用H4周期，SignalBar=1表示使用前一根已收盘K线的信号，避免了未收盘K线的信号漂移问题。
EA-11407.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the BnB (Bulls and Bears) custom indicator, which uses a configurable smoothing algorithm (supporting SMA, EMA, JJMA, T3, and other methods) to smooth volume-weighted bullish and bearish momentum. Entry conditions: when the indicator line Ind is above the signal line Sign, it indicates a bullish trend, and if the previous bar shows Ind crossing below Sign, a buy signal is triggered; conversely, when Ind is below Sign indicating a bearish trend, if Ind crosses above Sign on the previous bar, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions are automatically triggered by trend reversal—sell position closing occurs in bullish trends and buy position closing in bearish trends, supplemented by configurable StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio and the MMMode parameter for calculation mode. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe with SignalBar=1, using the previously closed bar's signal to avoid signal drift from unclosed bars.

EA-11408.strategy_analysis: 该EA本质上是一个图形界面工具，而非策略交易程序。它通过继承CSignalsDemoDialog类创建了一个830x400像素的对话框窗口，用于展示信号相关信息。程序在OnInit中创建并运行对话框，在OnDeinit中销毁对话框以释放资源，并在OnChartEvent中将图表事件转发给对话框处理。由于没有包含任何交易逻辑、入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理代码，该EA不具备自主交易能力，仅作为信号展示和交互的界面工具存在。所有核心功能均封装在SignalsDemoDialog.mqh文件中，当前文件仅负责对话框的生命周期管理和事件路由。
EA-11408.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is essentially a GUI utility rather than a strategy trading program. It creates an 830x400 pixel dialog window by inheriting from the CSignalsDemoDialog class, used for displaying signal-related information. The program creates and runs the dialog in OnInit, destroys it in OnDeinit to release resources, and forwards chart events to the dialog in OnChartEvent. Since there is no trading logic, entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management code included, this EA does not have autonomous trading capability and serves solely as an interface tool for signal display and interaction. All core functionality is encapsulated in the SignalsDemoDialog.mqh file, while the current file only handles dialog lifecycle management and event routing.

EA-1141.name: Exp_CMO
EA-1141.summary: This EA trades based on the CMO (Chande Momentum Oscillator) indicator, opening buy positions when the CMO crosses from negative to positive territory and sell positions when it crosses from positive to negative. It uses configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit levels, and only processes signals on new bars to avoid redundant trading.
EA-1141.summary_zh: 该EA基于CMO（钱德动量摆动指标）进行交易，当CMO从负值区域上穿至正值区域时开多仓，从正值区域下穿至负值区域时开空仓。它使用可配置的手数、止损和止盈水平，并仅在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重复交易。
EA-1141.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于CMO指标的零轴穿越进行动量交易。入场条件为：当CMO的前一根K线值大于0且当前K线值小于0时，产生买入信号；当CMO的前一根K线值小于0且当前K线值大于0时，产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发平仓（买入信号时平空仓，卖出信号时平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，具体逻辑未在本文件中展示。策略默认使用H4周期和14周期SMA平滑的CMO，信号取自第1根K线索引，属于延迟确认的趋势动量跟踪方法。
EA-1141.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum trading based on CMO indicator zero-line crossovers. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the previous CMO bar value is above zero and the current bar value drops below zero (crossing downward), while a sell signal is generated when the previous value is below zero and the current value rises above zero (crossing upward). Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, plus reverse signal exits where a buy signal closes short positions and a sell signal closes long positions. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management relies on external functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, whose internal logic is not visible in this file. The default configuration uses H4 timeframe with a 14-period SMA-smoothed CMO, reading signals from bar index 1, making it a lagging-confirmation trend momentum approach.

EA-11410.name: QuotesDemo
EA-11410.summary: This EA is a utility that fetches and displays Google Finance quotes (world indices, currencies, or bonds) via WebRequest in a custom dialog panel on the chart. It periodically updates the quotes every 10 seconds using a timer and does not place any trades.
EA-11410.summary_zh: 该EA是一个工具类程序，通过WebRequest从Google Finance获取并显示世界指数、货币或债券报价于图表上的自定义对话框面板中。它每10秒通过定时器更新报价，不进行任何交易操作。
EA-11410.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个报价展示工具。其核心功能是通过WebRequest函数从Google Finance网页抓取金融报价数据，包括世界指数、货币和债券三大类别。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用，没有持仓管理逻辑。仓位管理不适用，没有开仓或平仓的代码。资金管理不适用，该EA仅负责数据获取与UI展示，完全没有任何涉及资金管理的模块。定时器每10秒触发一次更新，通过GetTickCount进行节流控制防止过于频繁的请求。
EA-11410.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a quote display utility. Money management is not applicable as the EA only handles data retrieval and UI display with absolutely no money management module. The timer triggers updates every 10 seconds with GetTickCount-based throttling to prevent excessively frequent requests.

EA-11415.summary: This EA uses the BvsB (Bears vs Bulls) custom indicator to generate trading signals based on crossover logic between the indicator line and its signal line. It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses below the signal line from above, and sell positions when it crosses above from below, with configurable position sizing, stop loss, and take profit. The EA supports multiple smoothing methods and applied price types through the SmoothAlgorithms library.
EA-11415.summary_zh: 该EA使用BvsB（空头vs多头）自定义指标，基于指标线与信号线的交叉逻辑生成交易信号。当指标线从上方穿越信号线时开多仓，从下方穿越时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理、止损和止盈。通过SmoothAlgorithms库支持多种平滑方法和适用价格类型。
EA-11415.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是BvsB指标的交叉信号交易，属于动量反转类型策略。入场条件为：当指标线(Ind)在上一根K线高于信号线(Sign)且当前K线指标线低于等于信号线时，触发买入信号；反之当指标线在上一根K线低于信号线且当前K线指标线高于等于信号线时，触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖止损和止盈的固定点数设置，同时支持基于信号反向的平仓（BUY_Close/SELL_Close）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、亏损后余额或固定手数五种模式。资金管理委托给TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数处理。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，并设置了Deviation参数控制滑点容忍度。
EA-11415.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is crossover signal trading based on the BvsB indicator, which falls under the momentum/reversal category. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the indicator line (Ind) was above the signal line (Sign) on the previous bar and crosses to below-or-equal on the current bar; conversely, a sell signal triggers when Ind was below Sign and crosses above-or-equal. Exit conditions rely on fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points, while also supporting signal-based position closing (BUY_Close/SELL_Close when the opposite signal appears). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, or fixed lot size. Money management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades, and includes a Deviation parameter to control slippage tolerance.

EA-11418.name: Exp_KaufWMAcross
EA-11418.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the KaufWMAcross custom indicator, which combines Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (AMA) with a weighted moving average (LWMA). It opens buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals, with configurable position closing logic and money management modes.
EA-11418.summary_zh: 该EA基于KaufWMAcross自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标结合了考夫曼自适应移动平均线(AMA)和线性加权移动平均线(LWMA)。在向上交叉信号时开多仓，向下交叉信号时开空仓，支持可配置的平仓逻辑和资金管理模式。
EA-11418.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是考夫曼自适应移动平均线(AMA)与线性加权移动平均线(LWMA)的交叉系统。入场条件为：当AMA上穿LWMA时产生UpValue信号，开多仓并平空仓；当AMA下穿LWMA时产生DnValue信号，开空仓并平多仓。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号或止损/止盈，同时EA会回溯历史柱检查是否已存在同向平仓信号以避免重复操作。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后自由保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1手或10%资金。该策略使用自适应均线，理论上在趋势市中能更快跟随价格变化，在震荡市中自动减速减少假信号。
EA-11418.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is a crossover system between the Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average (AMA) and a Linear Weighted Moving Average (LWMA). Entry conditions: when AMA crosses above LWMA, an UpValue signal is generated to open buy positions and close sell positions; when AMA crosses below LWMA, a DnValue signal is generated to open sell positions and close buy positions. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or stop-loss/take-profit levels, and the EA also retrospectively checks historical bars for existing closing signals to avoid redundant operations. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by free margin after floating loss, by balance after floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter, defaulting to 0.1 lots or 10% of capital. The strategy uses an adaptive moving average which theoretically tracks price faster during trending markets and automatically slows down during choppy markets to reduce false signals.

EA-11429.name: Exp_SimpleBars
EA-11429.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom SimpleBars indicator, which analyzes bar color patterns over a configurable period. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals a bullish shift and sell positions on a bearish shift, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options. The strategy only processes signals on new bars to avoid redundant entries.
EA-11429.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义SimpleBars指标的信号进行交易，该指标通过可配置周期的K线颜色模式分析趋势方向。当指标发出看涨转换信号时开多仓，发出看跌转换信号时开空仓，并支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。策略仅在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重复入场。
EA-11429.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于SimpleBars自定义指标生成的K线颜色信号进行交易决策。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的值为0且前一根值为1时，产生买入开仓信号；当值为1且前一根值为0时，产生卖出开仓信号。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的止损和止盈点数。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制每笔交易的风险敞口。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线周期仅计算一次信号，避免在同一根K线内重复交易。整体策略逻辑简洁，属于典型的K线颜色趋势跟踪方法。
EA-11429.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy generates trade decisions based on signals from the SimpleBars custom indicator, which analyzes bar color patterns. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 4 reads 0 with the previous bar reading 1, a buy open signal is generated; when it reads 1 with the previous bar reading 0, a sell open signal is generated. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals closing existing positions, combined with fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing supports multiple modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after loss adjustments for both free margin and balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration to regulate risk exposure per trade. The strategy employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar period, preventing redundant trades within the same bar. Overall, the strategy logic is straightforward, representing a typical bar-color trend following approach.

EA-11456.name: exp_statusbot
EA-11456.summary: This EA is a monitoring utility that writes account status, order notifications, and trade history reports to text files. It tracks opened and closed orders by comparing ticket arrays across ticks and outputs changes to a notify file. It does not open, modify, or close any trades on its own.
EA-11456.summary_zh: 该EA是一个监控工具，将账户状态、订单通知和交易历史报告写入文本文件。它通过逐tick比较订单号数组来追踪新开仓和已平仓的订单，并将变化输出到通知文件中。它本身不执行任何开仓、修改或平仓操作。
EA-11456.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个纯监控/报告工具。它不包含任何入场条件或出场条件，不会自动下单或平仓。其核心功能有三个：一是WriteStatus()函数，实时写入账户余额、当前持仓品种、方向、手数和浮动盈亏点数到status.txt；二是WriteNotify()函数，通过比较当前订单号数组和上一次tick的订单号数组，检测新增订单和已平仓订单，将变化写入notify.txt；三是WriteReport()函数，当账户余额变化时，读取历史订单并按平仓时间排序，生成包含开平仓时间、价格、手续费、掉期和盈亏的CSV格式报告。仓位管理和资金管理方面完全不存在，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。整体逻辑简单直接，但代码质量较低，存在变量作用域问题和排序效率低下的缺陷。
EA-11456.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a pure monitoring/reporting utility. It contains no entry or exit conditions and does not place or close any trades automatically. Its core functionality has three parts: first, WriteStatus() writes real-time account balance, current positions with symbol, direction, lot size, and floating profit in pips to status.txt; second, WriteNotify() detects newly opened and closed orders by comparing the current ticket array against the previous tick's ticket array, writing changes to notify.txt; third, WriteReport() reads historical orders when account balance changes, sorts them by close time using an inefficient O(n²) selection sort, and generates a CSV report with open/close times, prices, commission, swap, and profit. There is no position sizing or money management since the EA does not execute any trades. The overall logic is straightforward but the code quality is low, with variable scoping issues and an inefficient sorting algorithm.

EA-11468.name: MA L WORLD
EA-11468.summary: This EA uses a linearly weighted moving average (LWMA) crossover signal between a fast 12-period and slow 25-period MA to generate trade entries and exits. It trails positions using a 92-period EMA and manages risk with a fixed-margin money management module allocating 1% of margin per trade. The strategy is a standard MQL5 Standard Library-based trend following system with configurable signal thresholds and stop/take levels.
EA-11468.summary_zh: 该EA使用12周期快速LWMA与25周期慢速LWMA的交叉信号来产生交易入场和出场。它通过92周期EMA进行移动止损，并使用固定保证金资金管理模块，每笔交易分配1%的保证金。这是一个基于MQL5标准库的经典趋势跟踪系统，具有可配置的信号阈值和止损/止盈水平。
EA-11468.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于两条移动平均线的交叉来判断趋势方向：快速MA（12周期LWMA）上穿慢速MA（25周期LWMA）时产生买入信号，下穿时产生卖出信号。入场条件由信号阈值（ThresholdOpen=20）控制，只有当信号强度超过阈值时才开仓，信号强度低于关闭阈值（ThresholdClose=20）时平仓。出场条件包括固定止损（95点）和止盈（670点），同时使用92周期EMA作为移动止损跟踪趋势。仓位管理采用固定保证金比例方式，每笔交易使用1%的可用保证金，由CMoneyFixedMargin类实现。资金管理方面，止盈远大于止损（670:95约7:1的盈亏比），表明该策略依赖少数大盈利覆盖多次小亏损的趋势跟踪典型特征。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于经典的MA交叉趋势跟踪系统，但缺乏对震荡市场的过滤机制和更复杂的风险控制。
EA-11468.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the crossover of two moving averages to determine trend direction: a buy signal is generated when the fast MA (12-period LWMA) crosses above the slow MA (25-period LWMA), and a sell signal when it crosses below. Entry conditions are controlled by a signal threshold (ThresholdOpen=20), where trades are only opened when signal strength exceeds the threshold, and positions are closed when signal strength drops below the close threshold (ThresholdClose=20). Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss at 95 points and take profit at 670 points, along with a 92-period EMA trailing stop to follow trends. Position sizing uses a fixed margin percentage approach, allocating 1% of available margin per trade through the CMoneyFixedMargin class. In terms of money management, the take profit is significantly larger than the stop loss (670:95, approximately 7:1 reward-to-risk ratio), which is characteristic of trend-following strategies that rely on a few large winners to cover multiple small losses. The overall strategy logic is clear and follows a classic MA crossover trend-following approach, but it lacks filters for ranging markets and more sophisticated risk controls.

EA-1150.name: T3MA(MTC)
EA-1150.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the T3MA-ALARM custom indicator, which detects direction changes of a double-smoothed moving average. It opens buy positions when the smoothed MA turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with optional reverse-close logic. Positions are managed with configurable stop loss and take profit in points.
EA-1150.summary_zh: 该EA基于T3MA-ALARM自定义指标的交易信号运行，该指标通过双重平滑移动平均线检测方向变化。当平滑MA向上转向时开多仓，向下转向时开空仓，并支持反向信号平仓功能。仓位通过可配置的点数止损和止盈进行管理。
EA-1150.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重平滑移动平均线（MA的MA）的方向变化来捕捉趋势转折点。入场条件为：当BufDir从-1变为1时产生买入信号（BufBuy不为零），当BufDir从1变为-1时产生卖出信号（BufSell不为零），指标缓冲区1和2分别对应买入和卖出箭头信号。出场条件有两种方式：一是通过可配置的止损和止盈点数平仓，二是通过RevClose参数启用反向信号平仓——即出现卖出信号时平掉多仓，出现买入信号时平掉空仓。仓位管理方面，仅使用固定手数（Lots参数），SolveLots函数直接返回输入的手数值，没有任何动态仓位调整或资金管理逻辑。资金管理基本缺失，没有基于账户余额或风险比例的动态手数计算，也没有追踪止损或部分平仓机制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合趋势明显的市场，但在震荡市中可能频繁止损。
EA-1150.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on detecting direction changes of a double-smoothed moving average (MA of MA) to capture trend reversal points. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when BufDir changes from -1 to 1 (BufBuy buffer non-zero), and a sell signal when BufDir changes from 1 to -1 (BufSell buffer non-zero), using indicator buffers 1 and 2 respectively. Exit conditions operate in two ways: first through configurable stop loss and take profit in points, and second through the RevClose parameter which enables reverse-signal closing — closing long positions on sell signals and short positions on buy signals. Position sizing uses only a fixed lot size (Lots parameter), with the SolveLots function directly returning the input value without any dynamic sizing or money management logic. Money management is essentially absent — there is no dynamic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage, nor any trailing stop or partial close mechanism. The overall strategy is simple and direct, suitable for trending markets, but may suffer frequent stop-outs in choppy or ranging conditions.

EA-1151.name: Exp_CoeffofLine_true
EA-1151.summary: This EA trades based on the CoeffofLine_true custom indicator, which measures the coefficient of a linear regression line to determine market momentum direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses from negative to positive territory and sell positions when it crosses from positive to negative, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1151.summary_zh: 该EA基于CoeffofLine_true自定义指标进行交易，该指标通过线性回归系数判断市场动量方向。当指标从负值穿越到正值时开多仓，从正值穿越到负值时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损止盈水平。
EA-1151.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用CoeffofLine_true指标作为核心策略信号，该指标基于线性回归系数衡量价格趋势的强度和方向。入场条件为：当指标值从负转正（Value[1]>0且Value[0]<0的穿越确认）时买入，当指标值从正转负（Value[1]<0且Value[0]>0的穿越确认）时卖出。出场条件包括：止损和止盈固定点数平仓，以及反向信号平仓（多仓在卖出信号时平仓，空仓在买入信号时平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数实现，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，包括BuyPositionOpen、SellPositionOpen等。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时通过SignalBar参数允许在当前K线上即时响应信号。
EA-1151.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the CoeffofLine_true indicator as its core strategy signal, which measures the strength and direction of price trends based on the linear regression coefficient. Entry conditions are: buy when the indicator crosses from negative to positive (Value[1]>0 and Value[0]<0 crossover confirmation), and sell when the indicator crosses from positive to negative (Value[1]<0 and Value[0]>0 crossover confirmation). Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as reverse signal exits (long positions close on sell signals, short positions close on buy signals). Position sizing is controlled through the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit percentage-based sizing. Money management relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions including BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades, while the SignalBar parameter allows immediate signal response on the current bar when set to zero.

EA-1152.name: Exp_ColorBBCandles
EA-1152.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBBCandles custom indicator, which uses Bollinger Band deviation levels to classify candle colors. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward bias (value > 5) and sell positions when it signals a downward bias (value < 5), while closing all positions when a flat/neutral signal (value == 5) is detected.
EA-1152.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBBCandles自定义指标进行交易，该指标利用布林带偏差水平对K线颜色进行分类。当指标值大于5时开多单，小于5时开空单，等于5时判定为盘整并平掉所有持仓。
EA-1152.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于布林带偏差水平的多层分类，通过ColorBBCandles指标将K线分为上涨、下跌和盘整三种状态。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的值从前一根K线大于5且当前K线值小于6时开多单；当值从前一根K线小于5且当前K线值大于4时开空单。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及当指标值等于5时判断为盘整并平掉所有持仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的函数实现，支持按比例分配或固定手数两种模式。策略采用多周期架构，指标可在不同于图表的时间周期上运行，默认使用H4周期。
EA-1152.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on multi-level classification of Bollinger Band deviation levels, using the ColorBBCandles indicator to categorize candles into bullish, bearish, and flat states. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when indicator buffer 4's previous value exceeds 5 and the current value is below 6; a sell signal triggers when the previous value is below 5 and the current value exceeds 4. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus closing all positions when the indicator value equals 5 (flat/neutral market). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management relies on functions from the included TradeAlgorithms.mqh file, supporting both proportional allocation and fixed lot modes. The strategy uses a multi-timeframe architecture where the indicator can operate on a different timeframe than the chart, defaulting to H4.

EA-1156.name: TwoDirectionMartin
EA-1156.summary: A bi-directional martingale EA that simultaneously places BUY_LIMIT and SELL_LIMIT pending orders at a fixed TP distance from the current price. When one side is triggered and price moves against it, the EA recalculates total volume using martingale logic to recover losses plus profit, then repositions both orders closer to the current price with increased lot sizes. It continuously shrinks the order range to force price back into the profitable zone.
EA-1156.summary_zh: 一个双向马丁格尔EA，同时在当前价格上下方放置BUY_LIMIT和SELL_LIMIT挂单。当一侧被触发且价格逆向运动时，EA通过马丁格尔逻辑重新计算总仓位以回收亏损并获利，然后将两侧重单移近当前价格并加大手数。它持续缩小挂单范围以迫使价格回到盈利区间。
EA-1156.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：这是一个双向马丁格尔策略，核心思想是同时在不同方向下限价单，利用价格回归获利。入场条件：初始时在当前买价上方放置SELL_LIMIT单，在当前卖价下方放置BUY_LIMIT单，距离由KTP参数计算的TP值决定。出场条件：没有显式止损，仅依赖反向挂单被触发后的整体获利出场，通过TP距离确保每笔交易盈利点差以上。仓位管理：当一侧订单被触发后价格继续远离，ShrinkRange函数根据当前浮亏重新计算总仓位量，公式为NewTotalVol=(OldLOSS+WinPerTrade)/TP，其中OldLOSS是两侧未实现亏损之和。资金管理：使用PercentSame参数控制主方向占总仓位的比例，剩余部分分配给反向对冲单，VolumeLimitOrder限制单笔订单最大手数。该策略没有止损保护，完全依赖价格回归来平仓，在单边行情中浮亏将无限扩大，属于极高风险的马丁格尔策略。
EA-1156.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This is a bi-directional martingale system that places pending limit orders on both sides of the current price, aiming to profit from price reversion. Entry conditions: On initialization, the EA places a BUY_LIMIT below the bid price and a SELL_LIMIT above the ask price, with distance determined by the TP value calculated from the KTP parameter percentage of price. Exit conditions: There is no explicit stop-loss; the strategy relies on overall profit when price reverts to the opposite pending order's take-profit level, with each cycle targeting at least the spread as profit. Position sizing: When one side is triggered and price moves away, the ShrinkRange function recalculates total volume using the formula NewTotalVol=(OldLOSS+WinPerTrade)/TP, where OldLOSS is the sum of unrealized losses from both sides. Money management: The PercentSame parameter controls what percentage of total volume goes to the dominant direction, while the remainder is allocated to the hedging opposite side; VolumeLimitOrder caps individual order size to avoid broker rejection. The strategy has no stop-loss protection and depends entirely on price mean reversion, meaning floating losses will grow indefinitely in trending markets, making this an extremely high-risk martingale approach.

EA-1158.name: Exp_2pbIdealMA
EA-1158.summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system based on two custom indicators (2pbIdeal1MA and 2pbIdeal3MA) to generate buy and sell signals. It opens positions when the faster 1-MA crosses above/below the slower 3-MA, and closes positions on the reverse crossover. Position sizing is controlled by a flexible money management parameter that supports either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based allocation.
EA-1158.summary_zh: 该EA基于两个自定义指标(2pbIdeal1MA和2pbIdeal3MA)的双重均线交叉系统来产生买卖信号。当快速的1-MA向上/向下穿越慢速的3-MA时开仓，反向交叉时平仓。仓位管理通过灵活的资金管理参数支持固定手数或按比例分配。
EA-1158.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于自定义理想移动平均线的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当2pbIdeal1MA从下方穿越2pbIdeal3MA时产生买入信号，从上方穿越时产生卖出信号，这是典型的双均线交叉趋势跟踪逻辑。出场条件包括反向均线交叉平仓以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算仓位大小。EA在每个新K线出现时检测信号，避免逐tick重复交易，这是一种合理的信号过滤方式。策略使用了三层平滑的理想移动平均线（3MA指标），通过多级粗调和精调平滑减少假信号，但所有周期参数均设为10，缺乏差异化配置。资金管理参数允许较大的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)，风险收益比为1:2，但在高波动市场中止损可能不足。
EA-1158.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy based on custom ideal moving average indicators. Entry conditions are triggered when 2pbIdeal1MA crosses above 2pbIdeal3MA for buy signals and below for sell signals, representing a classic dual MA crossover trend-following logic. Exit conditions include reverse MA crossover position closure along with fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional allocation. The EA detects signals on each new bar rather than every tick, which is a sensible approach to avoid duplicate trades and reduce noise. The strategy uses a triple-smoothed ideal moving average (3MA indicator) with multi-level rough and fine smoothing to reduce false signals, but all period parameters default to 10, lacking differentiated configuration. The money management allows a large stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) with a 1:2 risk-reward ratio, though the stop loss may be insufficient in highly volatile markets.

EA-1159.name: Exp_2MoHLC
EA-1159.summary: This EA trades based on the 2MoHLC custom indicator, which generates a cloud from two moving averages. It supports two modes: cloud color change (trend reversal) and cloud breakthrough (price breaking through the cloud boundary), opening buy/sell positions accordingly with configurable stop loss and take profit.
EA-1159.summary_zh: 该EA基于2MoHLC自定义指标进行交易，该指标通过两个移动平均线生成云带。支持两种模式：云带变色（趋势反转）和云带突破（价格突破云带边界），根据信号开仓做多或做空，并设有可配置的止损和止盈。
EA-1159.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于2MoHLC指标生成的上下云带（UpValue和DnValue），通过两种模式判断趋势方向。在CloudColor模式下，当上轨大于下轨时判断为上升趋势，若前一周期上下轨交叉则产生买入信号；反之产生卖出信号。在Breakdown模式下，当收盘价突破云带上轨时做多，跌破云下轨时做空。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及趋势反转时的平仓信号（BUY_Close/SELL_Close）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现，包含滑点保护和信号时间戳机制。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免逐tick重复交易。
EA-1159.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the 2MoHLC indicator which generates upper and lower cloud bands (UpValue and DnValue) from two moving averages with different periods. In CloudColor mode, an uptrend is identified when the upper band is above the lower band, and a buy signal is generated when the bands cross from the previous bar; conversely for sell signals. In Breakdown mode, a buy signal occurs when the close price breaks above the maximum of both cloud bands, and a sell signal when it breaks below the minimum. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as position closing on trend reversal signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot size and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen) with slippage protection and signal timestamp mechanisms. The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are only calculated on new bar formation, preventing repeated trades on every tick.

EA-1160.name: 20_200 expert_v4.2_AntS
EA-1160.summary: This EA compares open prices of two bars at configurable shifts and opens a buy or sell position when the price difference exceeds a threshold. It employs a martingale-style lot multiplication after losses and uses a fixed trading hour for entries. Positions are closed by take-profit, stop-loss, or a maximum holding time.
EA-1160.summary_zh: 该EA通过比较两个可配置偏移K线的开盘价，当价差超过阈值时开多或开仓。亏损后采用马丁格尔式加仓倍数放大手数，并在固定交易小时入场。仓位通过止盈、止损或最大持仓时间出场。
EA-1160.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于两根K线开盘价的差值判断方向：当第二根K线开盘价高于第一根K线超过Delta_L个点时做多，当第一根K线开盘价高于第二根K线超过Delta_S个点时做空。入场条件还包括限制在每天指定的小时(TradeTime)才允许开仓，且当前没有持仓。出场条件包括固定点数的止盈止损，以及最大持仓时间(MaxOpenTime)超时后强制平仓。仓位管理方面，提供固定手数和自动手数两种模式，自动手数根据账户余额按阶梯表递增。资金管理采用马丁格尔策略：当检测到上次记录的余额高于当前余额（即亏损后），手数乘以BigLotSize倍数放大；OneMult参数控制是一次性放大还是每笔新仓位都放大。该EA的LotSize函数是一段超长的if-else阶梯，将余额从300到273580分别映射到0.01到10.00手，完全没有使用数学公式计算。
EA-1160.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on comparing the open prices of two bars at configurable shifts (t1 and t2): a buy signal triggers when the second bar's open price exceeds the first bar's by more than Delta_L points, and a sell signal triggers when the first bar's open exceeds the second by more than Delta_S points. Entry conditions also restrict trading to a specific hour of the day (TradeTime) and require no existing position. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss in points, plus a forced close after MaxOpenTime hours. Position sizing offers both fixed lots and an auto-lot mode that scales with account balance via a hard-coded lookup table. Money management employs a martingale approach: when the recorded balance from the last trade exceeds the current balance (indicating a loss), the lot size is multiplied by BigLotSize. The OneMult parameter controls whether the multiplied lot is used once or repeatedly for each new position until profit. The LotSize function is an extremely long if-else chain mapping balance from 300 to 273580 to lot sizes from 0.01 to 10.00, with no mathematical formula used.

EA-1161.name: Kloss
EA-1161.summary: The Kloss EA is a mean-reversion trading system that uses CCI, Stochastic, and LWMA to identify overbought/oversold conditions for entry. It opens buy positions when CCI is deeply oversold, Stochastic main is below a threshold, and price is above the MA, and vice versa for sell signals. It features an MWMode mechanism that defers SL/TP placement until after position open to avoid broker rejection on tight stops.
EA-1161.summary_zh: Kloss EA是一个均值回归交易系统，使用CCI、随机指标和LWMA来识别超买超卖条件进行入场。当CCI深度超卖、随机指标主线下穿阈值且价格高于均线时买入，反之卖出。它具有MWMode机制，在仓位建立后再设置止损止盈，以避免因止损距离过近而被券商拒绝。
EA-1161.strategy_analysis: 该策略基于均值回归概念，认为价格偏离均值后会回归。入场条件：买入信号要求CCI低于-CCIDiffer（默认-120）、随机指标主线低于50-StDiffer（默认30）、且收盘价高于LWMA均线；卖出信号则相反，CCI高于+CCIDiffer、随机指标高于50+StDiffer、收盘价低于均线。出场条件有两种：一是止损止盈触发（默认各550点），二是当RevClose开启时，反向信号出现即平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于风险的动态手数计算，当Lots=0时使用账户自由保证金乘以MaximumRisk计算手数。资金管理通过fLotsNormalize函数将手数规范化为符合券商最小手数和步长要求。MWMode机制是一个巧妙设计，先用0止损止盈开仓，然后在下一个tick通过PositionModify设置真实止损止盈，并调整至满足StopsLevel要求，避免开仓时止损过近被拒绝。
EA-1161.strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is based on the mean reversion concept, assuming that prices will revert to the mean after deviating. Entry conditions: a buy signal requires CCI below -CCIDiffer (default -120), Stochastic main line below 50-StDiffer (default 30), and close price above the LWMA; sell signals are the mirror opposite with CCI above +CCIDiffer, Stochastic above 50+StDiffer, and close below the MA. Exit conditions come in two forms: stop loss/take profit triggers (default 550 points each), or reverse signal closure when RevClose is enabled. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and risk-based dynamic lot calculation, where Lots=0 triggers calculation using account free margin multiplied by MaximumRisk divided by 1000. Money management is handled by fLotsNormalize which rounds lot size to conform with broker minimum volume and step requirements. The MWMode mechanism is a clever design that opens positions with zero SL/TP first, then modifies them on subsequent ticks via PositionModify, adjusting to satisfy StopsLevel requirements and avoiding rejection for stops being too close at order time.

EA-1162.name: Smatf
EA-1162.summary: This EA uses a multi-timeframe scoring system based on 5 SMAs (periods 5,8,13,21,34) across 3 timeframes and the Accelerator Oscillator to generate buy/sell signals. Each indicator contributes a score, and positions are opened when the aggregate score exceeds configurable thresholds. It includes stop loss, take profit, trailing stop, and basic position management.
EA-1162.summary_zh: 该EA使用基于3个时间周期上5条SMA（周期5、8、13、21、34）和加速振荡器的多周期评分系统来生成买卖信号。每个指标贡献一个分数，当综合评分超过可配置阈值时开仓。包含止损、止盈、追踪止损和基本仓位管理功能。
EA-1162.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是综合多时间周期多均线方向与加速振荡器的评分系统。入场条件为：三个时间周期（M15、H1、H4）的上涨评分或下跌评分均超过50（OpenLevel=0时）则开仓，超过75则为强信号。每个时间周期中，5条SMA若当前值大于前值则贡献1分（上涨），反之为0分；AC指标若符合特定连续递增/递减模式则贡献3分，总分乘以12.5得到百分比评分。出场条件为：反向评分超过CloseLevel阈值时平仓，也可设置止损止盈出场。仓位管理采用固定手数（默认0.1手），无动态调仓机制。资金管理方面缺乏风控逻辑，无最大回撤限制或账户权益保护机制。追踪止损功能仅在价格超过开仓价后才开始生效，属于保本型追踪。
EA-1162.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a multi-timeframe, multi-moving-average scoring system combined with the Accelerator Oscillator. Entry conditions require that all three timeframes (M15, H1, H4) show directional consensus — the aggregate up-score or down-score must exceed 50 on each timeframe simultaneously, with scores above 75 indicating stronger signals. Within each timeframe, 5 SMAs each contribute 1 point if rising (current > previous), and the AC indicator contributes 3 points if it shows a specific sequential momentum pattern, with the total multiplied by 12.5 to produce a percentage. Exit conditions trigger when the opposite-direction score exceeds the CloseLevel threshold, or via fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (default 0.1) with no dynamic adjustment based on equity or volatility. Money management is essentially absent — there is no drawdown limit, no equity protection, and no lot-scaling logic. The trailing stop only activates after price moves beyond the open price, functioning as a breakeven-style trailing mechanism.

EA-1163.name: VLT_TRADER
EA-1163.summary: This EA places BuyStop and SellStop pending orders based on breakout signals from the iVLT custom indicator. When a signal is detected on a new bar, it sets pending orders at a configurable distance above the previous bar's high and below the previous bar's low, with optional stop-loss and take-profit levels. Existing pending orders are deleted once a position is opened to avoid duplicate entries.
EA-1163.summary_zh: 该EA基于iVLT自定义指标的突破信号，在前一K线的高低点上下方设置BuyStop和SellStop挂单。当新K线出现信号时，在可配置距离处挂单，并支持止损和止盈。持仓后自动删除未成交挂单，避免重复进场。
EA-1163.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于iVLT指标的突破信号，在前一K线高点上方和低点下方分别挂BuyStop和SellStop订单，属于典型的突破策略。入场条件为：iVLT指标第2个缓冲区在前一K线不返回EMPTY_VALUE时产生信号，且当前无持仓且无挂单时才设置新的挂单。出场条件完全依赖止损和止盈参数，EA本身不主动平仓，也缺少移动止损或信号反转平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数，SolveLots函数仅返回输入参数Lots，fLotsNormalize函数虽存在但未被调用，缺乏动态仓位调整能力。资金管理方面没有基于账户余额或风险比例的动态计算，固定手数可能导致不同账户规模下风险暴露不一致。挂单管理上，一旦持仓成功则删除所有未成交挂单，防止重复进场，这是较好的风控设计。但信号函数SignalOpenBuy/Sell/CloseBuy/CloseSell均为空实现，表明策略可能未完全开发或有冗余代码。
EA-1163.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a breakout system based on the iVLT custom indicator, placing BuyStop and SellStop pending orders above and below the previous bar's high and low respectively. Entry conditions require the iVLT indicator's buffer 2 to return a non-EMPTY_VALUE on the previous bar, combined with no existing position and no existing stop orders before placing new pending orders. Exit conditions rely entirely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters with no trailing stop or signal-based exit logic, meaning the EA cannot adapt to changing market conditions after entry. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size input with no dynamic adjustment; the SolveLots function simply returns the input Lots parameter, and the fLotsNormalize function exists but is never called. Money management lacks any account-balance-based or risk-percentage-based calculation, so the same lot size applies regardless of account equity, creating inconsistent risk exposure across different account sizes. The pending order management is well-designed—when a position exists, all remaining stop orders are deleted to prevent duplicate entries. However, the SignalOpenBuy, SignalOpenSell, SignalCloseBuy, and SignalCloseSell functions are all empty stubs returning false, indicating either incomplete development or significant dead code.

EA-11637.name: VR Heads or Tails
EA-11637.summary: VR Heads or Tails is a coin-flip style EA that randomly decides market direction (heads=buy, tails=sell) and employs a Martingale position sizing strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade to recover losses. It is essentially a gambling-based system with no technical analysis, relying purely on probability and progressive lot scaling to achieve net profit.
EA-11637.summary_zh: VR Heads or Tails是一个抛硬币式EA，随机决定市场方向（正面=买入，反面=卖出），并采用马丁格尔仓位管理策略，在每次亏损后加倍手数以回收损失。该系统本质上是一个基于赌博逻辑的交易策略，不使用任何技术分析，完全依赖概率和递增仓位来追求盈利。
EA-11637.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于随机概率，类似于抛硬币决定买入或卖出，没有任何技术指标或市场分析的参与。入场条件完全随机，通过随机数生成器决定开多或开空，不考虑价格走势、趋势方向或市场状态。出场条件依赖于止盈和止损设置，但核心机制在于亏损后加倍仓位。仓位管理采用经典马丁格尔策略，每次亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，试图用一次盈利覆盖之前所有亏损。资金管理方面，由于手数呈指数增长，连续亏损会迅速耗尽账户余额，风险极高。该策略没有任何风控机制来限制最大连续亏损次数或最大仓位上限，账户爆仓风险极大。
EA-11637.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on random probability, similar to flipping a coin to decide buy or sell, with no technical indicators or market analysis involved. Entry conditions are entirely random, using a random number generator to determine whether to open a long or short position, disregarding price action, trend direction, or market conditions. Exit conditions rely on take-profit and stop-loss settings, but the core mechanism lies in doubling position size after a loss. Position sizing employs the classic Martingale strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade in an attempt to recover all previous losses with a single win. Money management is extremely risky as the lot size grows exponentially, meaning a series of consecutive losses can quickly deplete the entire account balance. There is no risk control mechanism to limit the maximum number of consecutive losses or a maximum position cap, making account blow-up a very real possibility.

EA-1167.name: Exp_2pbIdealXOSMA
EA-1167.summary: This EA trades based on the 2pbIdealXOSMA custom indicator, which is a triple-smoothed oscillator with adjustable smoothing. It generates buy signals when the oscillator histogram turns upward and sell signals when it turns downward, using the slope direction of consecutive histogram bars to determine entries.
EA-1167.summary_zh: 该EA基于2pbIdealXOSMA自定义指标进行交易，该指标是带有可调平滑参数的三重平滑振荡器。当振荡器柱状图转向上方时产生买入信号，转向下方时产生卖出信号，通过连续柱状图条的方向变化来判断入场。
EA-1167.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于2pbIdealXOSMA指标，这是一个三重理想移动平均振荡器，通过三组平滑周期（X、Y、Z）分别进行粗平滑和调整平滑，再对直方图进行额外平滑处理。入场条件：当macd[1]<macd[2]（直方图从下降转为上升）且macd[0]>macd[1]（确认上升动能）时开多仓；当macd[1]>macd[2]且macd[0]<macd[1]时开空仓。出场条件：使用固定点数的止损和止盈，同时允许通过信号反向平仓——当出现卖出信号时平多头，出现买入信号时平空头。仓位管理方面，MM参数为负值时表示固定手数，为正值时表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制，默认值-0.1表示使用0.1手固定手数交易。策略依赖新K线检测（IsNewBar）来避免重复信号，仅在每根新K线时重新计算交易信号。
EA-1167.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the 2pbIdealXOSMA indicator, a triple ideal moving average oscillator that applies three pairs of rough and adjusting smoothing periods (X, Y, Z), followed by an additional smoothing pass on the histogram. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when macd[1]<macd[2] (histogram transitions from declining to rising) and macd[0]>macd[1] (confirming upward momentum); a sell signal triggers when macd[1]>macd[2] and macd[0]<macd[1]. Exit conditions use fixed stop loss and take profit in points, while also permitting signal-based exits—long positions close on sell signals and short positions close on buy signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot sizes while positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management defaults to MM=-0.1, meaning a fixed 0.1 lot per trade. The strategy relies on new bar detection (IsNewBar) to prevent duplicate signals, recalculating trading signals only on each new bar formation.

EA-11777.name: Double trading
EA-11777.summary: This EA implements a pairs trading / statistical arbitrage strategy by simultaneously opening opposite-direction positions on two correlated currency pairs when their correlation reaches a threshold. It monitors combined profit of both positions and closes them when the total profit target is hit, while also relying on StopLoss/TakeProfit as fallback exits. Auto mode determines trade direction based on session-specific currency strength assumptions.
EA-11777.summary_zh: 该EA实现了一种配对交易/统计套利策略，当两个相关货币对的相关系数达到阈值时，同时开立相反方向的仓位。它监控两个仓位的合计利润，达到目标利润后同时平仓，同时以止损/止盈作为兜底退出。自动模式根据交易时段的货币强度假设来确定交易方向。
EA-11777.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA基于两个货币对之间的相关性进行统计套利，当相关系数接近设定阈值(-0.98±0.003)时开仓。入场条件：相关系数CorrelationBuffer[0]落入Open_Value±Demis_Value范围内，且当日为允许交易的星期、没有持仓时触发入场。自动模式下，根据GMT时段判断主流货币的强弱趋势来决定买卖方向（如欧洲时段EUR/CHF/GBP为强势货币），直接模式(default AutoD)两对货币开反向仓，镜像模式(AutoM)两对货币开同向仓。出场条件：双仓合计利润达到Profit参数(默认20)时同时反向平仓，或任一仓位触发止损/止盈后等待另一仓位也被止损/止盈。仓位管理：两对货币分别使用独立手数Lot1和Lot2，默认1和1.3，不设动态加仓或减仓逻辑。资金管理：无动态资金管理，固定手数交易，止损止盈均为5000点，属于较宽的止损设置。
EA-11777.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA performs statistical arbitrage based on the correlation between two currency pairs, opening positions when the correlation coefficient approaches a threshold (-0.98 ± 0.003). Entry conditions: triggered when CorrelationBuffer[0] falls within Open_Value ± Demis_Value range, the current day is an allowed trading day, and no positions are open. In auto mode, trade direction is determined by session-based currency strength assumptions (e.g., EUR/CHF/GBP are dominant during European session); in default mode (AutoD) the two pairs open opposite directions, while mirror mode (AutoM) opens same-direction positions. Exit conditions: both positions are closed simultaneously when combined profit reaches the Profit parameter (default 20), or when one position hits SL/TP, the EA waits for the other to also be stopped out or take profited. Position sizing: two independent lot sizes Lot1 and Lot2 (default 1 and 1.3), with no dynamic scaling logic. Money management: no dynamic money management; fixed lot trading with wide SL/TP of 5000 points each.

EA-1179.name: Exp_Oracle
EA-1179.summary: This EA trades based on the custom Oracle indicator, offering three signal modes: zero-line breakthrough, signal line direction change, and indicator/signal line crossover. It opens buy/sell positions with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, and can independently control entry and exit permissions for long and short positions.
EA-1179.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义Oracle指标进行交易，提供三种信号模式：零线突破、信号线方向变化和指标与信号线交叉。它通过可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈水平开立多空仓位，并可独立控制多空方向的入场和出场权限。
EA-1179.strategy_analysis: 策略基于自定义Oracle指标生成交易信号，该指标包含主线和信号线两个缓冲区。EA提供三种入场算法：breakthrough模式检测信号线穿越零轴；twist模式检测信号线方向反转；disposition模式检测主线与信号线的交叉。入场信号仅在检测到新K线时计算，避免重复交易。出场条件通过买入/卖出平仓权限控制，当反向信号出现时平掉对应仓位。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表存款比例。止损和止盈分别设为1000点和2000点，风险回报比为1:2。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，并通过Recount机制在数据不足时重试。
EA-1179.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy generates trading signals based on the custom Oracle indicator, which features two buffers: a main line and a signal line. The EA offers three entry algorithms: breakthrough mode detects when the signal line crosses the zero axis; twist mode detects when the signal line changes direction; disposition mode detects crossovers between the main line and signal line. Entry signals are only calculated on new bar detection, preventing repeated trades within the same bar. Exit conditions are controlled by buy/sell close permissions, closing opposite positions when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing is managed via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Stop loss and take profit are set at 1000 and 2000 points respectively, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are computed only once per bar, with a Recount mechanism to retry when data is insufficient.

EA-1188.name: Exp_AdaptiveRenko
EA-1188.summary: This EA trades based on the AdaptiveRenko custom indicator, which uses ATR or StDev to dynamically size Renko bricks. It opens buy/sell positions when new Renko bricks signal a direction change, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-1188.summary_zh: 该EA基于AdaptiveRenko自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用ATR或标准差动态调整Renko砖块大小。当新Renko砖块发出方向变化信号时开仓，配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-1188.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于自适应Renko图表，通过ATR或标准差指标动态计算砖块厚度，实现根据市场波动率自动调整的突破交易。入场条件为：当指标第2缓冲区（UpVal）在信号K线有值且前一根无值时触发买入信号，当第3缓冲区（DnVal）在信号K线有值且前一根无值时触发卖出信号，这本质上捕捉的是Renko砖块方向反转的时刻。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），以及反向信号平仓（如买入信号触发时平空头）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现，策略本身没有追加仓位或加码逻辑。该策略的优势在于Renko过滤了市场噪音，自适应砖块大小能适应不同波动环境，但缺乏对滑点和点差的过滤。
EA-1188.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on adaptive Renko charts, where brick size is dynamically calculated using either the ATR or Standard Deviation indicator, enabling breakout trading that auto-adjusts to market volatility. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator's buffer 2 (UpVal) has a value on the signal bar but not on the previous bar, and a sell signal triggers when buffer 3 (DnVal) has a value on the signal bar but not on the previous bar—this essentially captures Renko brick direction reversals. Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), plus reverse-signal closes (e.g., closing shorts when a buy signal fires). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter: negative values represent a fixed lot size, while positive values represent a percentage of the deposit. Money management relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, with no pyramiding or position-addition logic in the strategy itself. The strategy benefits from Renko's noise-filtering property and adaptive brick sizing for varying volatility regimes, but lacks spread and slippage filters.
