EA-15753.name: Exp_ColorRsiMACD
EA-15753.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the ColorRsiMACD custom indicator, which combines RSI and MACD with advanced smoothing algorithms. It offers four operating modes including MACD zero-line breakdown, MACD histogram twist, signal line twist, and MACD/signal disposition crossover. Positions are opened and closed according to the selected mode with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit settings.
EA-15753.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorRsiMACD自定义指标信号进行交易，该指标结合了RSI和MACD并采用高级平滑算法。提供四种运行模式：MACD零轴突破、MACD柱状图转向、信号线转向和MACD与信号线交叉。根据所选模式开仓和平仓，并支持可配置的资金管理和止损止盈设置。
EA-15753.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ColorRsiMACD指标，该指标将RSI应用于多种自定义价格类型，然后通过用户可选的平滑算法（如T3、JJMA、JurX等）计算快速和慢速移动平均线的差值作为MACD值，再对MACD值进行平滑得到信号线。策略提供四种入场模式：一是零轴突破模式，当MACD值从负转正时做多，从正转负时做空；二是MACD柱状图转向模式，当MACD柱状图从下降转为上升时做多，从上升转为下降时做空；三是信号线转向模式，当信号线方向发生反转时入场；四是MACD与信号线交叉模式，当MACD从信号线下方穿越到上方时做多，反之作空。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于资金比例的两种模式，通过MM参数控制资金使用比例。资金管理使用MarginMode枚举选择手数计算方式，允许根据账户余额百分比动态调整仓位大小。
EA-15753.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the ColorRsiMACD indicator, which applies RSI to various custom price types and then calculates the difference between fast and slow moving averages using user-selectable smoothing algorithms (T3, JJMA, JurX, etc.) as the MACD value, then smooths the MACD to produce a signal line. The strategy offers four entry modes: first, the zero-line breakdown mode goes long when MACD crosses from negative to positive and short when it crosses from positive to negative. Second, the MACD histogram twist mode enters long when the MACD histogram changes from declining to rising, and short when it changes from rising to declining. Third, the signal line twist mode enters on signal line direction reversal. Fourth, the MACD/signal crossover mode goes long when MACD crosses above the signal line and short when it crosses below. Exit conditions rely on reverse signals triggering position closure, along with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing supports both fixed lots and margin-percentage-based modes, controlled by the MM parameter. Money management uses the MarginMode enumeration to select lot calculation method, allowing dynamic position sizing based on account balance percentage.

EA-15764.name: Exp_iRSISign
EA-15764.summary: This EA trades based on signals from a custom iRSISign indicator, which generates buy signals when RSI crosses above the upper level and sell signals when RSI crosses below the lower level. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and independent toggles for opening and closing positions on each side.
EA-15764.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义iRSISign指标信号进行交易，当RSI突破上轨时产生买入信号，跌破下轨时产生卖出信号。支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，以及买卖方向开仓和平仓的独立开关。
EA-15764.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于RSI指标的超买超卖动量信号进行交易。入场条件为：当iRSISign指标的上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上出现非零且非空值时，触发买入开仓信号；当下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）出现非零且非空值时，触发卖出开仓信号。出场条件包括两部分：一是反向信号触发平仓（如出现卖出信号时平掉买单，出现买入信号时平掉卖单），二是止损止盈的硬性出场。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的自由保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理委托给TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数处理。EA还包含一个额外的历史回溯逻辑，当买卖方向同时启用开仓和平仓但当前没有平仓信号时，会向前遍历历史K线寻找最近的反向信号来设置平仓标志。
EA-15764.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA trades based on overbought/oversold momentum signals from the RSI indicator. Entry conditions: when the iRSISign indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) shows a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar, a buy open signal is triggered; when the lower buffer (buffer 0) shows a non-zero, non-empty value, a sell open signal is triggered. Exit conditions consist of two parts: first, reverse signal exits (a sell signal closes buy positions, a buy signal closes sell positions), and second, hard exits via stop loss and take profit. Position sizing supports five modes through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions. The EA also includes an additional historical lookback logic: when both open and close are enabled for buy/sell directions but no close signal exists on the current bar, it scans forward through historical bars to find the nearest reverse signal and sets the close flag accordingly.

EA-15771.name: Exp_iWPRSign
EA-15771.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iWPRSign indicator, which uses Williams' Percent Range (WPR) to generate buy and sell signals when the indicator crosses overbought/oversold levels. It opens and closes positions based on these momentum signals, with configurable money management and risk parameters.
EA-15771.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义iWPRSign指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标使用威廉姆斯百分比范围（WPR）在指标穿越超买/超卖水平时生成买卖信号。它根据这些动量信号开仓和平仓，并具有可配置的资金管理和风险参数。
EA-15771.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于威廉姆斯百分比范围（WPR）指标的动量信号进行交易。当WPR指标从超卖区域向上穿越-30水平时，产生买入信号；当WPR从超买区域向下穿越-70水平时，产生卖出信号。入场条件由iWPRSign自定义指标的两个缓冲区决定：缓冲区1为买入信号，缓冲区0为卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的设置，以及反向信号平仓——当买入信号出现时同时平掉卖出仓位，反之亦然。仓位管理通过MMMode参数支持五种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例和固定手数。EA还包含了一个额外的逻辑：当同时启用买入和卖出开仓与平仓时，会回溯历史K线查找最近的反向信号来决定是否平仓，以避免在没有明确反向信号的情况下错误平仓。资金管理通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现，支持多种仓位计算方式。
EA-15771.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA trades based on momentum signals from the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator. A buy signal is generated when WPR crosses above the -30 level from oversold territory, and a sell signal is generated when WPR crosses below the -70 level from overbought territory. Entry conditions are determined by the iWPRSign custom indicator's two buffers: buffer 1 for buy signals and buffer 0 for sell signals. Exit conditions include StopLoss and TakeProfit settings, as well as counter-signal closes — when a buy signal appears, existing sell positions are closed and vice versa. Position sizing supports five modes via the MMMode parameter: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by free margin after losses, by balance after losses, and fixed lot size. The EA also includes additional logic: when both buy and sell open/close are enabled, it looks back through historical bars to find the most recent counter-signal to decide whether to close positions, avoiding erroneous closes without a clear reversal signal. Money management is implemented through the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions supporting multiple position calculation methods.

EA-15780.name: Exp_Chaikin_Volatility_Stochastic
EA-15780.summary: This EA trades crossovers of the Chaikin Volatility Stochastic custom indicator, opening buy positions when oscillator1 crosses above oscillator2 and sell positions when it crosses below. It uses configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and supports multiple smoothing methods via the SmoothAlgorithms library.
EA-15780.summary_zh: 该EA基于蔡金波动性随机指标的自定义交叉信号进行交易，当振荡器1上穿振荡器2时开多仓，下穿时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理、止损止盈，并通过SmoothAlgorithms库提供多种平滑方法。
EA-15780.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于蔡金波动性随机指标的两条线交叉，属于振荡器类均值回归策略。入场条件为：当Osc1[1]>Osc2[1]且Osc1[0]<Osc2[0]时产生买入信号（即Osc1从上方下穿Osc2后反向），当Osc1[1]<Osc2[1]且Osc1[0]>Osc2[0]时产生卖出信号（即Osc1从下方向上穿越Osc2）。出场条件依赖固定止损和止盈参数，同时支持反向信号平仓（买入信号时平卖仓，卖出信号时平买仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制手数比例，MMMode决定是固定手数还是百分比风险模式。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数，结合止损止盈和滑点偏差进行订单管理。策略仅在新区块或指定信号K线时计算信号，避免重复计算。
EA-15780.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on crossover signals from two lines of the Chaikin Volatility Stochastic custom indicator, classifying it as an oscillator-based mean reversion approach. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] and Osc1[0]<Osc2[0] (Osc1 crosses below Osc2 from above then reverses), and a sell signal is generated when Osc1[1]<Osc2[1] and Osc1[0]>Osc2[0] (Osc1 crosses above Osc2 from below). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit parameters, while also supporting counter-signal closes (closing sell positions on buy signals and vice versa). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter as a lot fraction, with MMMode determining whether to use fixed lots or percentage-based risk sizing. Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms library's BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen functions, combining stop loss, take profit, and slippage deviation for order management. The strategy only calculates signals on new bars or the specified signal bar to prevent redundant computations.

EA-15781.name: Exp_iStochKomposter
EA-15781.summary: This EA trades based on the iStochKomposter custom indicator, which is a stochastic oscillator variant with ATR-based dynamic levels. It opens buy positions on upper level crossover signals and sell positions on lower level crossover signals, with configurable close-on-reverse-signal logic and basic money management options.
EA-15781.summary_zh: 该EA基于iStochKomposter自定义指标进行交易，该指标是带有ATR动态水平的随机振荡器变体。在超买区交叉信号时开多仓，在超卖区交叉信号时开空仓，支持可配置的反向信号平仓逻辑和基本资金管理选项。
EA-15781.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用iStochKomposter自定义指标作为核心策略信号源，该指标本质上是随机振荡器与ATR波动率结合的变体。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号柱上出现非零非空值时触发买入信号，同时可选择平掉空头仓位；当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）出现非零非空值时触发卖出信号，同时可选择平掉多头仓位。出场条件分为两种：一是通过反向信号平仓（如持多头时出现卖出信号），二是通过固定止损和止盈参数平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例或固定手数大小。该EA还实现了新K线检测机制以避免重复信号，并在开仓与平仓逻辑冲突时回溯历史柱寻找更早的平仓信号。
EA-15781.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the iStochKomposter custom indicator as its core signal source, which is essentially a stochastic oscillator variant combined with ATR-based volatility levels. Entry conditions are: when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar, a buy signal is triggered with an optional close of existing sell positions; when the lower buffer (buffer 0) produces a non-zero, non-empty value, a sell signal is triggered with an optional close of existing buy positions. Exit conditions operate in two ways: first through reverse signal closing (e.g., closing a long position when a sell signal appears), and second through fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter which sets either the risk percentage or fixed lot size depending on the selected mode. The EA also implements a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate signals, and when both open and close logic are enabled simultaneously, it backtracks through historical bars to find earlier close signals for conflict resolution.

EA-15790.name: Exp_ColorJFatl_Digit
EA-15790.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the ColorJFatl_Digit custom indicator, which is a JMA-smoothed FATL (Fast Adaptive Trend Line) with digit rounding. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions to an uptrend signal and sell positions on downtrend transitions, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-15790.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJFatl_Digit自定义指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标是经过JMA平滑处理的FATL（快速自适应趋势线）并带有数字取整功能。当指标转换为上升趋势信号时开多仓，转换为下降趋势信号时开空仓，具有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-15790.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于ColorJFatl_Digit指标的趋势跟踪信号。入场条件：当指标缓冲区1的值为2（上升趋势）且前一值为非2时触发做多信号，值为0（下降趋势）且前一值为非0时触发做空信号。出场条件：做多时如果指标从2变为0则触发平多仓，做空时如果指标从0变为2则触发平空仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制下单量比例，支持多种保证金模式包括固定手数、余额比例和可用保证金比例等。止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，盈亏比为2:1。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时支持用户选择是否开启买/卖方向的开仓和平仓功能。
EA-15790.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on trend-following signals from the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator, which combines JMA smoothing with FATL adaptive trend line analysis. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when indicator buffer 1 value equals 2 (uptrend) and the previous value was not 2, while a sell signal is triggered when the value equals 0 (downtrend) and the previous value was not 0. Exit conditions: long positions are closed when the indicator transitions from 2 to 0, and short positions are closed when it transitions from 0 to 2. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with support for multiple margin modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage. The default stop loss is set to 1000 points and take profit to 2000 points, yielding a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades, and users can independently enable or disable buy/sell opening and closing operations.

EA-15792.name: Exp_ColorX2MA_Digit
EA-15792.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorX2MA_Digit custom indicator, which uses a dual moving average crossover system with digit rounding. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from neutral to uptrend and sell positions when it transitions from neutral to downtrend, with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-15792.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorX2MA_Digit自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用带有数字舍入的双均线交叉系统。当指标从中性转为上升趋势时开多仓，从中性转为下降趋势时开空仓，具有可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈设置。
EA-15792.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双平滑移动平均线交叉策略，通过ColorX2MA_Digit指标产生信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区值从0（中性）变为大于0时开多仓，当从2（下降趋势）变为小于2时开空仓。出场条件包括：当指标显示下降趋势信号时平多仓，当显示上升趋势信号时平空仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金或固定手数的资金管理方式。策略使用了多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA等）来计算快速和慢速移动平均线，通过两阶段平滑过滤减少假信号。此外，指标支持价格偏移和数字舍入，进一步平滑信号输出。
EA-15792.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual smoothed moving average crossover strategy, generating signals through the ColorX2MA_Digit indicator. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when the indicator buffer transitions from 0 (neutral) to a value greater than 0, and open a sell position when it transitions from 2 (downtrend) to a value less than 2. Exit conditions include: closing buy positions when the indicator shows a downtrend signal, and closing sell positions when it shows an uptrend signal, along with fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points. Position sizing supports multiple modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin, or fixed lot money management. The strategy uses various smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) to compute fast and slow moving averages, filtering out false signals through two-stage smoothing. Additionally, the indicator supports price shifting and digit rounding for further signal output smoothing.

EA-15801.name: Exp_iDeMarkerSign
EA-15801.summary: This EA trades based on the iDeMarkerSign custom indicator, which generates overbought/oversold signals using the DeMarker oscillator with configurable upper and lower threshold levels. It opens buy positions when the DeMarker crosses below the lower level and sell positions when it crosses above the upper level, with optional counter-position closing and configurable money management modes.
EA-15801.summary_zh: 该EA基于iDeMarkerSign自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用DeMarker振荡器配合可配置的上下阈值产生超买超卖信号。当DeMarker跌破下限时开多单，突破上限时开空单，支持反向仓位平仓及多种资金管理模式。
EA-15801.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用DeMarker振荡器的超买超卖区域进行均值回归交易。入场条件为：当指标上轨信号线（buffer 1）在指定K线位置产生非零非空值时，视为超买信号，开多单并可选平空单；当指标下轨信号线（buffer 0）产生有效值时，视为超卖信号，开空单并可选平多单。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发时的平仓机制。仓位管理通过MMMode枚举支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后的自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后的余额比例、以及固定手数模式。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个时间周期只在新的K线形成时执行一次交易逻辑，避免重复开仓。额外的反向信号扫描逻辑会在历史K线中向前搜索，确认是否存在更早的反向信号以决定是否平仓，这在同时启用开仓和平仓信号时生效。
EA-15801.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is mean reversion trading using overbought/oversold zones of the DeMarker oscillator. Entry conditions: when the upper signal line (buffer 1) of the iDeMarkerSign indicator produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE at the specified signal bar, it is interpreted as an oversold bounce signal, triggering a buy open and optionally a sell close; when the lower signal line (buffer 0) produces a valid value, it signals overbought conditions, triggering a sell open and optionally a buy close. Exit conditions include fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points, as well as counter-signal-based position closing. Position sizing supports five money management modes via MMMode: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. The EA employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure trading logic executes only once per bar formation, preventing duplicate entries. An additional historical signal scan logic searches forward through past bars to find earlier counter-signals for closing decisions, which activates when both opening and closing signals are enabled simultaneously.

EA-15817.name: Exp_FRASMAv2
EA-15817.summary: This EA trades based on the FRASMAv2 (Fractal-adapted Simple Moving Average) custom indicator signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a neutral state to an uptrend signal and sell positions on transitions to a downtrend signal, with optional position closing on signal reversals.
EA-15817.summary_zh: 该EA基于FRASMAv2（分形自适应简单移动平均线）自定义指标信号进行交易。当指标从中性状态转为上涨信号时开多仓，转为下跌信号时开空仓，并可在信号反转时选择平仓。
EA-15817.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于FRASMAv2分形自适应移动平均指标，该指标通过分形维度调整移动平均线的速度以适应市场波动变化。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区值从0（中性）变为正值（Value[0]>0且Value[1]==0）时触发买入信号；当值从2（下跌趋势）变为小于2的值（Value[0]<2且Value[1]==2）时触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖信号反转：买入平仓在下跌信号出现时触发，卖出平仓在上涨信号出现时触发，且买卖平仓可分别通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数独立控制。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，并支持五种资金管理模式（可用保证金、余额、亏损保证金、亏损余额、固定手数）。止损和止盈分别固定为1000点和2000点，但缺乏动态调整机制。策略使用IsNewBar机制限制每根K线仅计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时通过SignalBar参数允许选择信号来源K线。
EA-15817.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on the FRASMAv2 fractal-adapted moving average indicator, which adjusts the moving average speed using fractal dimension to adapt to market volatility changes. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator buffer value transitions from 0 (neutral) to a positive value (Value[0]>0 and Value[1]==0), and a sell signal triggers when the value transitions from 2 (downtrend) to a value below 2 (Value[0]<2 and Value[1]==2). Exit conditions rely on signal reversals: buy positions close when a downtrend signal appears, and sell positions close when an uptrend signal appears, with each independently controllable via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter as a risk ratio, supporting five money management modes (free margin, balance, loss free margin, loss balance, and fixed lot). Stop loss and take profit are fixed at 1000 and 2000 points respectively, with no dynamic adjustment mechanism. The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to limit signal calculation to once per bar, preventing duplicate trades, while the SignalBar parameter allows selecting the signal source bar.

EA-15841.name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA
EA-15841.summary: This EA trades based on crossovers of a Volume Weighted Moving Average indicator. It opens buy positions when the VWMA turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-15841.summary_zh: 该EA基于成交量加权移动平均线(VWMA)指标的金叉死叉进行交易。当VWMA拐头向上时开多仓，拐头向下时开空仓，并提供可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-15841.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于成交量加权移动平均线(VWMA)的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：当VWMA前一值小于前二值且当前值大于前一值时，判定为上升趋势开启，触发买入信号；当VWMA前一值大于前二值且当前值小于前一值时，判定为下降趋势开启，触发卖出信号。出场条件包括固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号出现时的平仓。仓位管理采用五种模式：基于可用保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的可用保证金、扣除亏损后的余额比例计算仓位，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。策略使用新K线判断机制避免重复开仓，仅在确认新Bar或需要重新计算时才执行信号检测逻辑。
EA-15841.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend following system based on the Volume Weighted Moving Average (VWMA) indicator. Entry conditions: when the VWMA's previous value is less than the value before it and the current value exceeds the previous value, an uptrend is identified and a buy signal is triggered; when the VWMA's previous value exceeds the value before it and the current value falls below the previous value, a downtrend is identified and a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as position closing on reverse signals. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance percentage, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate entries, executing signal logic only when a new bar is confirmed or a recount is needed.

EA-15848.name: cm Universal Trailing Stop Hedge
EA-15848.summary: A universal trailing stop utility for MetaTrader 5 that supports 7 different trailing methods including fixed pips, fractals, ATR, Parabolic SAR, Moving Average, percentage of profit, and fixed distance. It can operate as either a real or virtual trailing stop and supports hedging accounts by calculating weighted average entry prices for buy and sell positions separately.
EA-15848.summary_zh: 一个通用的移动止损工具，支持7种不同的移动止损方式，包括固定点数、分形、ATR、抛物线指标、均线、利润百分比和固定距离。它既可以作为真实移动止损运行，也可以作为虚拟移动止损运行，并支持对冲账户通过分别计算买卖仓位的加权平均入场价来管理止损。
EA-15848.strategy_analysis: 该EA不是一个自主交易策略，而是一个移动止损管理工具。它的核心概念是根据用户选择的7种方法之一动态调整止损水平：固定点数、分形、ATR、抛物线SAR、均线、利润百分比或固定点距。对于真实移动止损模式，它通过TRADE_ACTION_SLTP修改仓位的止损价；对于虚拟移动止损模式，它不修改实际止损，而是在价格触及虚拟止损线时直接市价平仓。在对冲账户中，它计算所有买单和卖单的加权平均开仓价作为无亏损水平（NL），虚拟止损模式以该加权平均价作为基准计算止损位。出场条件为价格触及动态计算的止损位，没有独立的入场逻辑。仓位管理方面仅支持按Magic号筛选仓位，不具备独立的仓位大小计算或资金管理功能。参数StepTrall控制止损移动的最小步距以避免频繁修改，StartTrall设定止损开始跟踪的最低盈利点数阈值。
EA-15848.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an autonomous trading strategy but rather a trailing stop management utility. Its core concept is dynamically adjusting stop loss levels based on one of seven user-selected methods: fixed pips, fractals, ATR, Parabolic SAR, Moving Average, percentage of profit, or fixed distance. For real trailing stop mode, it modifies position stop losses via TRADE_ACTION_SLTP; for virtual trailing stop mode, it does not modify actual stop losses but instead closes positions at market when price hits the virtual stop line. On hedging accounts, it calculates the weighted average entry price for all buy and sell positions as the no-loss level (NL), and the virtual stop mode uses this weighted average as the basis for calculating stop levels. Exit conditions are price hitting the dynamically calculated stop level, with no independent entry logic. Position management only supports filtering by Magic number, lacking independent lot size calculation or money management capabilities. The StepTrall parameter controls the minimum step for stop loss adjustment to avoid frequent modifications, while StartTrall sets the minimum profit threshold in points before trailing begins.

EA-15849.name: Timer Trade
EA-15849.summary: A timer-based EA that alternates between buying and selling at fixed time intervals. It places a buy order when the trigger is 0 and a sell order when the trigger is 1, toggling between them on each timer event. No technical analysis or market conditions are evaluated — trades are executed purely on a time schedule.
EA-15849.summary_zh: 一个基于定时器的EA，按固定时间间隔在买入和卖出之间交替操作。当触发器为0时下买单，为1时下卖单，每次定时器事件触发时切换状态。不使用任何技术分析或市场条件判断，纯粹按时间计划执行交易。
EA-15849.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于定时器的时间驱动交易，完全不依赖任何技术指标或市场分析。入场条件仅取决于定时器触发和Trigger变量的当前状态：Trigger为0时执行买入，Trigger为1时执行卖出。出场条件依赖止损和止盈设置，止损和止盈以点数计算，买入止损设在当前Bid价减去止损点数，止盈设在Ask价加上止盈点数；卖出则相反。仓位管理非常简单，固定手数由TradeValue参数决定，没有任何动态仓位调整或资金管理逻辑。该策略没有检查现有持仓、账户余额或保证金，可能导致无限制地开仓。此外，定时器设置中存在一个关键bug：EventSetTimer的参数是TimerTime * 100，但EventSetTimer接受的单位是秒，而TimerTime的注释说是秒，乘以100后实际间隔远超预期。
EA-15849.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is purely time-driven trading based on a timer, without relying on any technical indicators or market analysis. Entry conditions depend solely on the timer event and the current state of the Trigger variable: a buy is executed when Trigger is 0, and a sell when Trigger is 1. Exit conditions rely on stop loss and take profit levels calculated in points — buy SL is set at current Bid minus SL points, buy TP at Ask plus TP points; sell positions are the reverse. Position sizing is simplistic, using a fixed lot size determined by the TradeValue parameter with no dynamic adjustment or money management logic. The strategy does not check existing positions, account balance, or margin requirements, which could lead to unlimited position opening. Furthermore, there is a critical bug in the timer setup: EventSetTimer takes TimerTime multiplied by 100, but since EventSetTimer's parameter unit is seconds and TimerTime is described in seconds, the actual interval is 100 times longer than the user likely intends.

EA-15852.name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA_StDev
EA-15852.summary: This EA trades based on a Volume-Weighted Moving Average with Standard Deviation channels. It generates buy and sell signals when price crosses the upper or lower StDev bands, or when the VWMA line direction changes, and manages positions with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-15852.summary_zh: 该EA基于成交量加权均线及标准差通道进行交易。当价格突破上下标准差通道或VWMA线方向改变时生成买卖信号，并通过可配置的止损止盈管理持仓。
EA-15852.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于成交量加权移动均线（VWMA）及其标准差通道的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件有三种模式：点模式（POINT）检测指标缓冲区中的箭头信号（上下标准差通道突破），直接模式（DIRECT）检测VWMA线的方向转折（金叉死叉），以及无信号模式（WITHOUT）。出场条件同样支持三种模式，买入平仓使用下通道突破或VWMA下降，卖出平仓使用上通道突破或VWMA上升。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金比例，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损自由保证金、亏损余额和固定手数五种模式。止损1000点、止盈2000点提供了1:2的风险回报比。标准差乘数dK1=1.5和dK2=2.5构建了双层通道，用于识别不同强度的趋势信号。
EA-15852.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on a Volume-Weighted Moving Average (VWMA) with Standard Deviation channels as a trend-following system. Entry conditions offer three modes: POINT mode detects arrow signals from indicator buffers (upper/lower StDev band breakouts), DIRECT mode detects VWMA line direction reversals (crossover logic using 3-bar comparison), and WITHOUT mode disables signals. Exit conditions mirror the three modes, using opposite band breakouts or VWMA direction changes to close positions. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting five margin modes: free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss-balance, and fixed lot size. The default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points provide a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The dual StDev multipliers dK1=1.5 and dK2=2.5 create two channel layers for identifying trend signals of varying strength.

EA-15873.name: Exp_Fisher_org_v1
EA-15873.summary: This EA trades based on the Fisher_org_v1 custom indicator, which is a Fisher Transform oscillator. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above its signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit levels.
EA-15873.summary_zh: 该EA基于Fisher_org_v1自定义指标进行交易，该指标是Fisher变换振荡器。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿信号线时开空仓，具有可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈设置。
EA-15873.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Fisher_org_v1指标作为核心交易信号源，Fisher变换是一种将价格数据转换为近似正态分布的振荡器，旨在更清晰地识别趋势转折点。入场条件为：当指标线Ind大于信号线Sign时视为上升趋势，若前一根K线的Ind小于等于Sign则产生买入信号；反之亦然产生卖出信号。出场条件由止损和止盈参数控制，同时支持反向信号平仓（买入信号触发空头平仓，卖出信号触发多头平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode模式控制，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后余额等多种资金管理方式，也支持固定手数。策略在每根新K线开盘时计算信号，避免逐tick重复交易，同时设置了SignalBar参数允许使用不同K线偏移来获取信号。
EA-15873.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Fisher_org_v1 indicator as its core signal source. The Fisher Transform is an oscillator that converts price data into an approximate Gaussian normal distribution, designed to more clearly identify trend turning points. Entry conditions: when the indicator line Ind is above the signal line Sign, an uptrend is identified, and if the previous bar's Ind was less than or equal to Sign, a buy signal is generated; the inverse logic generates sell signals. Exit conditions are controlled by StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters, with additional support for counter-signal closing (buy signal triggers sell position close, sell signal triggers buy position close). Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted balance-based money management modes, as well as fixed lot size. The strategy calculates signals only on new bar openings to avoid per-tick repeated trading, and includes a SignalBar parameter allowing different bar offsets for signal retrieval.

EA-15887.name: Exp_Fisher_org_v1_Sign
EA-15887.summary: This EA trades based on the Fisher_org_v1_Sign custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It uses configurable money management with multiple margin modes and supports separate controls for entry and exit signals. Positions are managed with stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-15887.summary_zh: 该EA基于Fisher_org_v1_Sign自定义指标进行交易，在向上信号时开多仓，在向下信号时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理，具有多种保证金模式，并分别控制入场和出场信号。仓位通过止损和止盈水平进行管理。
EA-15887.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Fisher变换指标(Fisher_org_v1_Sign)生成交易信号，Fisher变换将价格分布转换为近似正态分布，适合识别超买超卖区域。入场条件：当指标上轨缓冲区(UpValue)出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时开多仓，当指标下轨缓冲区(DnValue)出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值时开空仓。出场条件：指标出现反向信号时平仓，即上轨信号平空仓，下轨信号平多仓；同时支持止损和止盈出场。仓位管理：支持五种资金管理模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例和固定手数。资金管理：通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，结合MMMode选择计算模式。该EA还包含一个额外的逻辑——当买入和卖出同时启用且没有反向平仓信号时，会回溯历史K线查找较早的平仓信号。
EA-15887.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Fisher Transform indicator (Fisher_org_v1_Sign) to generate trading signals. The Fisher Transform converts price distributions into approximately Gaussian normal distributions, which is effective for identifying overbought and oversold conditions. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the upper buffer (UpValue) shows a non-zero and non-EMPTY_VALUE value, and a sell position is opened when the lower buffer (DnValue) shows a non-zero and non-EMPTY_VALUE value. Exit conditions: positions are closed on reverse signals — upper buffer signals close sell positions, and lower buffer signals close buy positions; stop loss and take profit levels also serve as exit mechanisms. Position sizing: the EA supports five money management modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. Money management: the MM parameter controls the risk ratio (default 0.1) combined with the MMMode selection for calculation mode. The EA also includes an additional logic — when both buy and sell are enabled and no reverse close signal is detected on the current bar, it scans historical bars backward to find an earlier close signal.

EA-15888.name: Exp_JFatl_Digit_System
EA-15888.summary: This EA trades based on the JFatl_Digit_System custom indicator, which combines a JMA (Jurik Moving Average) with FATL (Fast Adaptive Trend Line) digital filtering. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-15888.summary_zh: 该EA基于JFatl_Digit_System自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了JMA（Jurik移动平均线）与FATL（快速自适应趋势线）数字滤波。当指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损止盈水平。
EA-15888.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于JFatl_Digit_System指标，该指标融合了JMA平滑与FATL数字滤波技术，通过数字量化方式判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区6的值大于2且缓冲区0的值小于3时开多仓；当缓冲区6的值小于2且缓冲区0的值大于1时开空仓。出场条件通过独立的买卖平仓信号控制，与开仓信号分离，允许灵活的平仓逻辑。仓位管理通过MM参数控制下单量，支持五种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、按余额比例、按可用保证金比例等。止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，盈亏比为1:2，体现了趋势跟踪策略让利润奔跑的理念。策略仅在新增K线时计算信号，避免了逐笔计算的噪音干扰。
EA-15888.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the JFatl_Digit_System indicator, which fuses JMA smoothing with FATL digital filtering to determine trend direction through digital quantization. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 6 value is greater than 2 and buffer 0 value is less than 3; a sell position opens when buffer 6 value is less than 2 and buffer 0 value is greater than 1. Exit conditions are controlled by independent buy/sell close signals, decoupled from entry signals, allowing flexible closing logic. Position sizing is managed via the MM parameter, supporting five money management modes including fixed lots, balance-based, and free margin-based sizing. Stop loss is set at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio that reflects the trend-following philosophy of letting profits run. The strategy only calculates signals on new bars, avoiding noise from tick-by-tick computation.

EA-15889.name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System
EA-15889.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend. It uses volume-weighted moving average digit analysis to generate trend-following entries with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing is managed through a flexible margin mode system supporting lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage allocation.
EA-15889.summary_zh: 该EA基于Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System自定义指标信号进行交易，在指标发出上涨信号时开多仓，发出下跌信号时开空仓。它使用成交量加权移动平均数字分析来生成趋势跟踪入场信号，并配置了止损和止盈水平。仓位管理通过灵活的保证金模式系统实现，支持固定手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比分配。
EA-15889.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于成交量加权移动平均的数字系统，通过分析指标缓冲区的数值来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标颜色缓冲区值大于2且买入颜色值小于3时开多仓；当颜色缓冲区值小于2且卖出颜色值大于1时开空仓。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），同时支持反向信号平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、余额百分比、可用保证金百分比、亏损后可用保证金百分比和亏损后余额百分比。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险敞口比例，默认0.1表示10%的资金分配。策略在每根新K线或指定信号栏位时重新计算信号，避免频繁交易。
EA-15889.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a volume-weighted moving average digit system that determines trend direction by analyzing the indicator's buffer values. Entry conditions: open a buy position when the color buffer value is greater than 2 and the buy color value is less than 3; open a sell position when the color buffer value is less than 2 and the sell color value is greater than 1. Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points, with additional exit on opposite signal closure enabled. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, post-loss free margin percentage, and post-loss balance percentage. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 representing 10% capital allocation. The strategy recalculates signals on each new bar or at the specified signal bar, avoiding excessive trading frequency.

EA-15890.name: Trade panel with autopilot (TPA)
EA-15890.summary: A semi-automated trade panel EA that combines manual trading buttons with an autopilot mode. The autopilot uses a multi-timeframe price comparison signal (Open, High, Low, Close across 20 timeframes) to generate buy/sell percentage signals and automatically opens or closes positions when thresholds are breached. It also features an optional fractal-based stop loss mechanism.
EA-15890.summary_zh: 一个半自动交易面板EA，结合了手动交易按钮与自动驾驶模式。自动驾驶模式使用多周期价格比较信号（跨越20个时间周期的开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价）来生成买入/卖出百分比信号，当信号超过阈值时自动开仓或平仓。还具备基于分形的止损功能。
EA-15890.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多周期价格动量比较，通过比较当前K线与前一根K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价及其组合均值来判断市场方向。入场条件为：当买入信号百分比超过开仓阈值（默认85%）时开多仓，当卖出信号百分比超过开仓阈值时开空仓，且当前无持仓。出场条件为：当持仓方向对应的信号百分比低于平仓阈值（默认55%）时自动平仓，或通过面板手动平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数和权益百分比两种模式，最小手数为0.01。止损管理使用Fractals分形指标，在买入持仓时寻找最近的下分形作为止损位，卖出持仓时寻找最近的上分形作为止损位。策略遍历20个时间周期（M1到MN1）进行信号聚合计算，最终以百分比形式展示多空信号强度。
EA-15890.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on multi-timeframe price momentum comparison, judging market direction by comparing the current bar's Open, High, Low, Close and their composite averages against the previous bar across 20 timeframes. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the buy signal percentage exceeds the opening threshold (default 85%), and a sell position is opened when the sell signal percentage exceeds the threshold, provided no position currently exists. Exit conditions: the position is automatically closed when the signal percentage for the held direction falls below the closing threshold (default 55%), or manually via the panel's CLOSE button. Position sizing supports both fixed lot and equity percentage modes, with a minimum lot of 0.01. Stop loss management uses the Fractals indicator: for buy positions, the nearest lower fractal below current price is set as SL; for sell positions, the nearest upper fractal above current price is set as SL. The strategy iterates across 20 timeframes (M1 through MN1) for signal aggregation, ultimately displaying long/short signal strength as percentages.

pros: 多周期信号聚合提高了方向判断的可靠性，减少单一时间周期的噪音干扰
半自动设计兼顾了手动交易的灵活性和自动交易的纪律性
分形止损自适应市场波动结构，比固定点数止损更合理

面板界面友好，支持一键买卖和快速切换自动驾驶模式
pros_en: Multi-timeframe signal aggregation improves directional reliability and reduces single-timeframe noise
Semi-automated design balances manual trading flexibility with automated trading discipline
Fractal-based stop loss adapts to market volatility structure, more rational than fixed-pip SL
Visual signal percentage display (progress bar and color changes) intuitively shows market state
User-friendly panel interface supports one-click buy/sell and quick autopilot mode switching
cons: 信号计算方法过于简单，仅比较相邻两根K线的OHLC，缺乏对趋势强度和波动率的考量
无新K线检查机制，每个tick都重新计算全部20个周期的信号，计算效率低且可能频繁触发交易
开仓时未设置止损和止盈（SL=0, TP=0），分形止损仅在OnTrade回调中延迟设置，存在风险窗口
平仓阈值55%意味着信号只需略低于一半即平仓，可能导致过早退出盈利仓位
无法同时处理多品种，仅针对当前图表品种交易
cons_en: Signal calculation is overly simplistic, only comparing two adjacent bars' OHLC without considering trend strength or volatility
No new bar check mechanism; recalculates all 20 timeframes every tick, causing inefficiency and potential frequent trade triggers
No SL/TP set at position opening (SL=0, TP=0); fractal SL is set with delay in OnTrade callback, creating a risk window
Closing threshold of 55% means position closes when signal is just below half, potentially causing premature exits from profitable trades
Cannot handle multiple symbols simultaneously; only trades the current chart symbol
improvements: 增加新K线检查机制，避免每个tick重复计算信号和重复触发交易逻辑
开仓时立即设置初始止损，而不是依赖OnTrade回调延迟设置分形止损
增加信号过滤条件，如加入ATR波动率过滤或趋势强度确认，提高信号质量
improvements_en: Add new bar check mechanism to avoid recalculating signals and triggering trade logic on every tick
Set initial stop loss immediately at position opening instead of relying on delayed fractal SL in OnTrade callback
Add signal filtering conditions such as ATR volatility filter or trend strength confirmation to improve signal quality

risk_points: 开仓时止损和止盈均为0，存在无保护持仓的风险窗口
每个tick都执行交易逻辑且无新K线检查，可能在短时间内反复开平仓
仅依赖简单OHLC比较产生信号，在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁亏损
POSITION_SL与NULL比较的方式不规范，应使用0而非NULL检查止损是否设置
risk_points_en: SL and TP are both 0 at position opening, creating an unprotected position risk window
Trade logic executes every tick without new bar check, potentially causing rapid repeated open/close cycles
Signals based solely on simple OHLC comparison are prone to false signals in ranging markets, leading to frequent losses
Comparing POSITION_SL with NULL is non-standard; should use 0 instead of NULL to check if SL is set

EA-15899.name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MACandle
EA-15899.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom Volume_Weighted_MACandle indicator, which applies volume weighting to a MACD-style candle histogram. It opens buy positions when the indicator shifts from non-bullish to bullish (color=2) and sell positions when it shifts from non-bearish to bearish (color=0), with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-15899.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义的成交量加权MACD蜡烛指标(Volume_Weighted_MACandle)进行交易，该指标将成交量权重应用于MACD风格的蜡烛直方图。当指标从非牛市转为牛市(颜色=2)时开多仓，从非熊市转为熊市(颜色=0)时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈设置。
EA-15899.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是利用成交量加权MACD蜡烛指标判断市场动量方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的当前值Col[1]为2（看涨蜡烛）且前一值Col[0]小于2（非看涨）时，触发买入开仓信号；当Col[1]为0（看跌蜡烛）且Col[0]大于0（非看跌）时，触发卖出开仓信号。出场条件分为两部分：信号反向时根据BuyPosClose/SellPosClose参数平仓，以及固定的止损和止盈（默认1000点和2000点）。仓位管理采用MM参数控制交易量，支持固定手数或基于保证金的比例模式（MMMode参数）。资金管理通过MarginMode枚举选择LOT或其他保证金模式来决定每笔交易的仓位大小。EA还实现了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），仅在出现新K线时重新计算信号，避免重复交易。
EA-15899.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses a Volume-Weighted MACD Candle indicator to determine market momentum direction. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 4's current value Col[1] equals 2 (bullish candle) and the previous value Col[0] is less than 2 (non-bullish), a buy open signal is triggered; when Col[1] equals 0 (bearish candle) and Col[0] is greater than 0 (non-bearish), a sell open signal is triggered. Exit conditions are twofold: close positions on signal reversal via BuyPosClose/SellPosClose parameters, and fixed stop-loss/take-profit at default 1000 and 2000 points respectively. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either fixed lots or margin-based proportional sizing via the MMMode parameter (MarginMode enum). Money management selects between LOT or other margin modes to determine trade size for each position. The EA also implements a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar), recalculating signals only on new bars to prevent duplicate trades.

EA-15900.name: Exp_Donchian_Channels_System
EA-15900.summary: This EA trades breakout signals from the Donchian Channels System indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward breakout and sell positions on downward breakouts, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-15900.summary_zh: 该EA基于唐奇安通道系统指标的交易信号进行突破交易。当指标发出向上突破信号时开多仓，发出向下突破信号时开空仓，并提供可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-15900.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于唐奇安通道突破系统，利用价格突破通道上下轨产生交易信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区8的信号值大于2时，若Col[0]小于3则触发买入开仓信号，同时触发卖出平仓信号；当信号值小于2时，若Col[0]大于1则触发卖出开仓信号，同时触发买入平仓信号。出场条件包括固定点数的止损和止盈，以及反向信号触发的平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后的自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后的余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1即10%的资金投入。策略使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，SignalBar参数指定用于判断信号的K线位置，默认为1即前一根已完成的K线。
EA-15900.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Donchian Channel breakout system, generating trade signals when price breaks above or below the channel boundaries. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 8 signal value is greater than 2 and Col[0] is less than 3, a buy open signal is triggered alongside a sell close signal; when the signal value is less than 2 and Col[0] is greater than 1, a sell open signal is triggered alongside a buy close signal. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as position closing triggered by opposite signals. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 representing 10% capital allocation. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate signals, and the SignalBar parameter specifies which bar to evaluate for signals, defaulting to 1 (the last completed bar).

EA-15950.name: Exp_AroonOscillatorSignAlert
EA-15950.summary: This EA trades based on the Aroon Oscillator signals from the custom AroonOscillatorSignAlert indicator. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable buy/sell open/close toggles and money management options.
EA-15950.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义AroonOscillatorSignAlert指标的信号进行交易，在上方信号时开多仓，在下方信号时开空仓，并提供可配置的买卖开平仓开关及资金管理选项。
EA-15950.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Aroon振荡器指标信号，通过自定义指标AroonOscillatorSignAlert的上下缓冲区读取买卖信号。入场条件为：当指标上缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上输出非零且非空值时触发买入信号；当指标下缓冲区（buffer 0）输出非零且非空值时触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖两个方面：一是指标反向信号触发平仓（如持仓时出现反向信号则平仓），二是通过历史回溯检查是否已有更早的反向信号来确定是否需要平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举实现，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金及固定手数等多种模式计算仓位。止损和止盈分别固定为1000和2000点，并通过Deviation参数控制滑点容忍度。策略同时支持买卖双向开仓与平仓的独立开关控制，增加了灵活性。
EA-15950.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on Aroon Oscillator signals retrieved from the custom AroonOscillatorSignAlert indicator via its two buffers. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the upper buffer (buffer 1) outputs a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar; a sell signal triggers when the lower buffer (buffer 0) outputs a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE. Exit conditions rely on two mechanisms: reverse indicator signals close opposing positions, and a historical bar loop scans backward to find earlier opposing signals for closing positions. Position sizing uses the MM parameter combined with the MMMode enumeration, supporting multiple modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin, and fixed lot sizing. Stop loss and take profit are fixed at 1000 and 2000 points respectively, with a Deviation parameter controlling slippage tolerance. The strategy offers independent toggle switches for buy/sell open and close operations, adding configuration flexibility.

EA-15979.name: Exp_i-CAi
EA-15979.summary: This EA trades based on the i-CAi custom indicator, which is a smoothed moving average crossover system. It opens buy positions when the indicator value rises (bullish crossover) and sell positions when it falls (bearish crossover), with separate controls for entry and exit signals. The EA supports multiple smoothing algorithms and applied price types for flexible trend detection.
EA-15979.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-CAi自定义指标进行交易，该指标是一个平滑移动平均线交叉系统。当指标值上升（看涨交叉）时开多仓，当指标值下降（看跌交叉）时开空仓，并提供独立的入场和出场信号控制。EA支持多种平滑算法和应用价格类型，以实现灵活的趋势检测。
EA-15979.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于i-CAi指标的趋势跟踪，i-CAi指标本质上是经过多种平滑算法处理的移动平均线系统。入场条件为：当指标前一值小于更前一值（上升趋势），且当前值大于等于前一值时开多仓；反之，当指标前一值大于更前一值（下降趋势），且当前值小于等于前一值时开空仓。出场条件与入场条件对称：上升趋势触发平空仓，下降趋势触发平多仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举实现，支持基于自由保证金、余额、亏损保证金、亏损余额和固定手数五种资金管理模式。该EA使用了新K线检测机制（CIsNewBar类），仅在出现新K线时计算信号，避免重复交易。止损和止盈分别默认设为1000和2000点，提供了基本的风险控制。EA还使用LoadHistory函数确保历史数据加载完整，保证指标计算的准确性。
EA-15979.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on the i-CAi indicator, which is essentially a moving average system processed through multiple smoothing algorithms. Entry conditions are: when the indicator's previous value is less than the value before it (uptrend detected), and the current value is greater than or equal to the previous value, a buy position is opened; conversely, when the previous value is greater than the value before it (downtrend detected), and the current value is less than or equal to the previous value, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions are symmetric to entries: an uptrend triggers closing of sell positions, while a downtrend triggers closing of buy positions. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five money management modes based on free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss balance, and fixed lot size. The EA employs a new bar detection mechanism (CIsNewBar class), calculating signals only when a new bar appears to prevent redundant trading. Stop loss and take profit are set at default values of 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing basic risk control. The EA also uses the LoadHistory function to ensure complete historical data loading for accurate indicator calculation.

EA-15996.name: Exp_SMI_Correct
EA-15996.summary: This EA trades based on the SMI Correct indicator, which is a Stochastic Momentum Index variant with multi-layer smoothing. It generates buy signals when the SMI main line crosses above the signal line and sell signals on the reverse crossover, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit management.
EA-15996.summary_zh: 该EA基于SMI Correct指标进行交易，SMI Correct是随机动量指数的一种多层级平滑变体。当SMI主线从下方穿越信号线时生成买入信号，反向穿越时生成卖出信号，并支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈管理。
EA-15996.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于SMI Correct指标的主线与信号线交叉。入场条件为：当指标主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，从上方穿越信号线时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈，分别由StopLoss_和TakeProfit_参数控制，同时支持基于信号反向交叉的平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，并支持多种资金管理模式（可用保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、固定手数）。指标采用三重平滑（EMA、JJMA等），第一层平滑处理极值周期数据，第二层平滑主线，第三层平滑信号线。策略还使用了新K线判断机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线内重复交易。
EA-15996.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the crossover of the SMI Correct indicator's main line and signal line. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the main line crosses above the signal line, and a sell position opens when the main line crosses below the signal line. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit controlled by StopLoss_ and TakeProfit_ parameters, along with signal-based closing when the crossover reverses direction. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter which controls the risk percentage, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss-adjusted margin, and fixed lot size. The indicator employs triple smoothing (EMA, JJMA, etc.), where the first layer smooths the extremum period data, the second smooths the main line, and the third smooths the signal line. The strategy also uses a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trading within the same bar.

EA-16015.name: Exp_i-CAi_StDev
EA-16015.summary: This EA trades based on the i-CAi_StDev custom indicator, which combines a smoothed moving average with standard deviation bands. It supports three signal modes for both entry and exit: point signals from indicator arrows, direct trend reversal detection from the MA line, or no signal at all, allowing flexible configuration of buy/sell open and close logic independently.
EA-16015.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-CAi_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了平滑移动平均线和标准差通道。它支持三种信号模式用于入场和出场：指标箭头的点信号、均线趋势反转的直接检测，或完全不使用信号，允许独立灵活配置买入/卖出的开仓和平仓逻辑。
EA-16015.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于i-CAi_StDev指标进行均值回归交易。指标由一条平滑移动平均线（支持SMA、EMA、JJMA等多种平滑方法）和基于标准差计算的上下通道组成。入场条件有两种模式：POINT模式通过指标缓冲区2-5中的箭头信号判断买卖点，DIRECT模式通过均线拐头判断趋势反转——买入信号为均线先降后升（V形底），卖出信号为先升后降（倒V形顶）。出场条件同样支持两种模式：POINT模式通过反向箭头信号平仓，DIRECT模式通过均线方向变化判断。仓位管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的五种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于净值等。标准差乘数dK1和dK2控制通道宽度，用于判断价格偏离程度，从而识别均值回归机会。
EA-16015.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is mean reversion trading based on the i-CAi_StDev indicator. The indicator consists of a smoothed moving average line (supporting multiple smoothing methods including SMA, EMA, JJMA, etc.) and upper/lower bands calculated from standard deviation. Entry conditions operate in two modes: POINT mode uses arrow signals from indicator buffers 2-5 to identify buy/sell points, while DIRECT mode detects trend reversals from the MA line—a buy signal occurs when the line turns from declining to rising (V-bottom), and a sell signal occurs when it turns from rising to declining (inverted V-top). Exit conditions similarly support two modes: POINT mode closes positions on opposite arrow signals, and DIRECT mode closes when the MA direction changes. Position sizing uses five money management modes from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, including fixed lot, balance percentage-based, and equity-based options. The standard deviation multipliers dK1 and dK2 control the channel width, used to gauge price deviation levels and identify mean reversion opportunities.

EA-16037.name: Exp_PFE
EA-16037.summary: This EA trades based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, opening buy positions when PFE turns upward and sell positions when PFE turns downward. It uses the CXMA smoothing library for signal refinement and supports configurable money management modes including lot-based and percentage-based sizing.
EA-16037.summary_zh: 该EA基于极化分形效率(PFE)指标进行交易，当PFE向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓。它使用CXMA平滑算法库对信号进行优化，并支持包括固定手数和百分比仓位在内的多种资金管理模式。
EA-16037.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于极化分形效率(PFE)指标的方向性转折来捕捉趋势动量变化。入场条件为：当PFE指标前一根值低于前两根值且当前值高于前一值时触发做多信号；当PFE前一根值高于前两根值且当前值低于前一值时触发做空信号。出场条件通过独立的买入平仓和卖出平仓开关控制，在反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的可用保证金、基于扣除亏损后的余额，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1。止损和止盈分别默认设为1000和2000点，提供了较好的风险回报比。策略使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易，并设置了滑点容忍度以应对市场波动。
EA-16037.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on directional reversals of the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator to capture trend momentum shifts. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when PFE's previous bar value is below the bar before it AND the current value is above the previous value; a sell signal triggers when PFE's previous bar value is above the bar before it AND the current value is below the previous value. Exit conditions are controlled by independent buy-close and sell-close switches, closing positions when opposing signals appear. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default risk ratio of 0.1. Stop loss and take profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing a reasonable risk-reward ratio. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same bar and sets a slippage tolerance to handle market volatility.

EA-16044.name: Exp_PFE_Extr
EA-16044.summary: This EA trades based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, opening buy positions when PFE crosses above the upper level from below and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level from above. It uses customizable smoothing methods and supports multiple money management modes with configurable stop loss and take profit.
EA-16044.summary_zh: 该EA基于极化分形效率(PFE)指标进行交易，当PFE从下方穿越上轨时开多仓，从上方穿越下轨时开空仓。它支持多种平滑方法和资金管理模式，并配有可配置的止损和止盈。
EA-16044.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于极化分形效率(PFE)指标的动量交易。入场条件为：当PFE指标值高于上轨(+0.5)且前一根K线的值低于上轨时，产生买入信号；当PFE指标值低于下轨(-0.5)且前一根K线的值高于下轨时，产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置，以及当反向信号出现时平仓（如买入信号出现时平空仓，卖出信号出现时平多仓）。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后可用保证金、基于亏损后余额、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择资金管理模式。EA还使用了CXMA平滑算法库来平滑PFE指标值，支持JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等多种平滑方法。信号仅在指定时间周期的新K线出现时计算，避免重复交易。
EA-16044.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is momentum trading based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the PFE value is above the upper level (+0.5) and the previous bar's value was at or below the upper level; a sell signal is generated when the PFE value is below the lower level (-0.5) and the previous bar's value was at or above the lower level. Exit conditions include hard stop loss and take profit settings, as well as closing positions when opposing signals appear (e.g., closing sell positions on buy signals and closing buy positions on sell signals). Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio and the MMMode parameter for selecting the management mode. The EA also uses the CXMA smoothing algorithm library to smooth PFE indicator values, supporting multiple smoothing methods including JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, and AMA. Signals are only calculated on new bars of the specified timeframe to prevent repeated trading within the same bar.

EA-16066.name: Exp_PPO_Cloud
EA-16066.summary: This EA trades based on the PPO_Cloud custom indicator, which is a Percentage Price Oscillator variant with configurable smoothing algorithms. It opens buy positions when the PPO line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with optional position closing on reverse signals.
EA-16066.summary_zh: 该EA基于PPO_Cloud自定义指标进行交易，该指标是百分比价格振荡器(PPO)的变体，支持多种可配置的平滑算法。当PPO线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿信号线时开空仓，并支持反向信号平仓。
EA-16066.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于百分比价格振荡器(PPO)云图指标，通过快慢两条平滑线的差值与信号线的关系判断动量方向。入场条件为：当指标线在信号线上方且前一根柱指标线低于或等于信号线时，产生买入信号；当指标线在信号线下方且前一根柱指标线高于或等于信号线时，产生卖出信号，本质上是一个动量穿越策略。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发的平仓功能。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净自由保证金比例、按净余额比例以及固定手数五种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1即10%的资金用于交易。该策略使用可配置的新K线检测机制(SignalBar=1时逐Tick检测)，支持多种平滑算法(SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA)增强指标灵活性。
EA-16066.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the PPO_Cloud indicator, which uses the relationship between a fast-slow smoothed difference line and a signal line to determine momentum direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator line is above the signal line and the previous bar's indicator line was at or below the signal line; a sell signal is generated when the indicator line is below the signal line and the previous bar's indicator line was at or above the signal line, making it fundamentally a momentum crossover strategy. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus optional position closing on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by net free margin percentage, by net balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter, defaulting to 0.1 (10% of funds for trading). The strategy uses a configurable new bar detection mechanism (tick-by-tick when SignalBar=1), and supports multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) for enhanced indicator flexibility.

EA-16081.name: Exp_CandlesticksBW
EA-16081.summary: This EA trades based on the CandlesticksBW custom indicator, which appears to classify candlestick patterns into numeric categories. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals a bullish pattern and sell positions when a bearish pattern is detected, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
EA-16081.summary_zh: 该EA基于CandlesticksBW自定义指标进行交易，该指标将K线形态分类为数值类别。当指标发出看涨形态信号时开多仓，发出看跌形态信号时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-16081.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用CandlesticksBW自定义指标识别K线形态，通过指标缓冲区4的数值判断市场方向。入场条件为：当指标值小于2时视为看涨信号，若Value[0]大于1则开多仓；当指标值大于3时视为看跌信号，若Value[0]小于4则开空仓。出场条件包括：看涨信号时同时平空仓，看跌信号时同时平多仓，以及固定的止损和止盈水平。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数或基于资金的两种模式。资金管理使用MMMode参数选择LOT或百分比模式，默认为0.1手。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复入场。
EA-16081.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the CandlesticksBW custom indicator to identify candlestick patterns, determining market direction through the numeric values of indicator buffer 4. Entry conditions: when the indicator value is less than 2, it is considered a bullish signal, and if Value[0] is greater than 1, a buy position is opened; when the indicator value is greater than 3, it is considered a bearish signal, and if Value[0] is less than 4, a sell position is opened. Exit conditions include: closing sell positions on bullish signals, closing buy positions on bearish signals, along with fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting either fixed lot or margin-based modes. Money management uses the MMMode parameter to select between LOT or percentage-based sizing, defaulting to 0.1 lots. The strategy employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar period, preventing duplicate entries.

EA-16100.name: Exp_RAVI_Histogram
EA-16100.summary: This EA trades based on the RAVI_Histogram custom indicator, which compares fast and slow moving average values to detect trend strength. It opens buy positions when the histogram crosses above the upper level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level, with configurable money management and position closing logic.
EA-16100.summary_zh: 该EA基于RAVI_Histogram自定义指标进行交易，通过比较快慢均线的差值来检测趋势强度。当直方图上穿上限水平时开多仓，下穿下限水平时开空仓，并具有可配置的资金管理和平仓逻辑。
EA-16100.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RAVI（Range Action Verification Index）指标的直方图形式，通过计算快速平滑均线与慢速平滑均线的差值百分比来衡量趋势强度。入场条件为：当直方图值大于上限水平（默认+0.1）且前一根柱的值低于上限时开多仓；当直方图值小于下限水平（默认-0.1）且前一根柱的值高于下限时开空仓。出场条件包括：多仓在直方图跌破下限时平仓，空仓在直方图涨破上限时平仓，同时可设置止损和止盈。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损自由保证金比例、按亏损余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制仓位占比，MMMode参数选择仓位计算方式。EA使用了新柱检测机制避免重复信号，并支持多时间框架分析。
EA-16100.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the RAVI (Range Action Verification Index) indicator in histogram form, measuring trend strength by calculating the percentage difference between a fast smoothed moving average and a slow smoothed moving average. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the histogram value exceeds the upper level (default +0.1) and the previous bar's value was at or below that level; a sell position opens when the histogram value falls below the lower level (default -0.1) and the previous bar's value was at or above that level. Exit conditions include closing buy positions when the histogram drops below the lower level and closing sell positions when it rises above the upper level, with configurable stop loss and take profit. Position sizing supports multiple modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of loss-free margin, percentage of loss-balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for position proportion and MMMode for the calculation method. The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate signals and supports multi-timeframe analysis.

EA-16109.name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI
EA-16109.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI custom indicator, which applies spectral analysis smoothing to the Relative Vigor Index. It opens buy positions when the RVI main line crosses above its signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit levels.
EA-16109.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对相对活力指数(RVI)应用频谱分析平滑处理。当RVI主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，反之时开空仓，具有可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈设置。
EA-16109.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是利用经过频谱分析平滑处理的RVI指标产生交易信号。入场条件为：当RVI主线Line1上穿信号线Line2时，如果上一根K线Line1仍在Line2下方，则触发买入开仓信号；反之，当Line1下穿Line2且前一根K线Line1在Line2上方时，触发卖出开仓信号。出场条件包括：买入信号触发时同时平掉卖出仓位，卖出信号触发时同时平掉买入仓位，以及固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理采用两种模式：按资金比例（MM参数）或固定手数（LOT模式），通过MMMode参数选择。资金管理方面，MM参数控制每次交易使用的资金比例，默认0.1。该EA使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，并通过SignalBar参数允许在指定K线上计算信号，提高了灵活性。频谱分析参数N和SS用于控制RVI指标的平滑程度，N决定频谱长度，SS决定平滑因子。
EA-16109.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses trading signals generated by an RVI indicator that has been smoothed using spectral analysis. Entry conditions: when the RVI main line (Line1) crosses above the signal line (Line2) and the previous bar had Line1 below Line2, a buy entry signal is triggered; conversely, when Line1 crosses below Line2 and the previous bar had Line1 above Line2, a sell entry signal is triggered. Exit conditions include closing sell positions when a buy signal occurs, closing buy positions when a sell signal occurs, and fixed stop loss/take profit levels. Position sizing supports two modes: percentage of margin (MM parameter) or fixed lot size (LOT mode), selectable via the MMMode parameter. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter which defaults to 0.1, determining the proportion of margin used per trade. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate signals and uses the SignalBar parameter to allow signal calculation on a specified bar, improving flexibility. The spectral analysis parameters N and SS control the smoothing degree of the RVI indicator, with N determining the spectral length and SS determining the smoothing factor.

EA-16117.name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR
EA-16117.summary: This EA trades based on the spectral analysis of the Williams Percent Range (WPR) indicator. It generates buy signals when the spectrally-smoothed WPR value rises between consecutive bars and sell signals when it falls, with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit management.
EA-16117.summary_zh: 该EA基于威廉百分比范围(WPR)指标的频谱分析信号进行交易。当频谱平滑后的WPR值在连续K线间上升时产生买入信号，下降时产生卖出信号，并配备可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈机制。
EA-16117.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是利用频谱分析对WPR指标进行平滑处理，去除噪声后捕捉动量方向变化。入场条件：当平滑WPR值Value[1]<Value[2]（动量向上）且Value[0]>=Value[1]时开多单；当Value[1]>Value[2]（动量向下）且Value[0]<=Value[1]时开空单。出场条件：多单在动量向下时平仓，空单在动量向上时平仓，同时设有1000点止损和2000点止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举实现，支持按余额百分比、可用保证金百分比或固定手数等多种模式。资金管理包含在TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中，提供从保守到激进的多种资金管理方案。信号仅在新生成K线时计算，避免同根K线内重复交易。
EA-16117.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept uses spectral analysis (FFT-based filtering) to smooth the WPR indicator, removing noise to capture genuine momentum direction changes. Entry conditions: a buy signal fires when the smoothed WPR shows Value[1]<Value[2] (upward momentum) and Value[0]>=Value[1] (current bar continues rising); a sell signal fires when Value[1]>Value[2] (downward momentum) and Value[0]<=Value[1]. Exit conditions: long positions close when momentum turns downward, short positions close when momentum turns upward, with a fixed 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit. Position sizing is handled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting percentage of balance, percentage of free margin, or fixed lot modes. Money management logic is encapsulated in the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, offering multiple approaches from conservative to aggressive. Signal calculation is restricted to new bar formation via the CIsNewBar class, preventing repeated trades within the same bar.

EA-16122.name: Exp_wlxBW5Zone
EA-16122.summary: This EA trades based on the wlxBW5Zone custom indicator, which identifies Bill Williams' Zone signals. It opens buy positions on upward zone signals and sell positions on downward zone signals, with optional counter-position closing based on the same indicator readings.
EA-16122.summary_zh: 该EA基于wlxBW5Zone自定义指标进行交易，该指标识别比尔·威廉姆斯的区域信号。在向上区域信号时开多仓，在向下区域信号时开空仓，并可根据同一指标读数选择性平掉反向仓位。
EA-16122.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于比尔·威廉姆斯的第五区域（BW5 Zone）信号，通过wlxBW5Zone自定义指标识别市场动量区域。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（Buffer 1）在指定信号柱上产生非零且非空值时，触发买入信号；当指标下轨缓冲区（Buffer 0）产生有效信号时，触发卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及在反向信号出现时平掉当前持仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除亏损后的可用保证金比例、按扣除亏损后的余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例或固定手数，MMMode参数决定具体的资金管理方式。EA还包含了一个额外逻辑：当同时允许开仓和平仓但当前没有平仓信号时，会向后搜索历史K线以寻找可能的平仓触发信号。
EA-16122.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on Bill Williams' Fifth Zone (BW5 Zone) signals, identified through the wlxBW5Zone custom indicator which detects market momentum zones. Entry conditions: when the indicator's upper buffer (Buffer 1) produces a non-zero and non-empty value on the specified signal bar, a buy signal is triggered; when the lower buffer (Buffer 0) produces a valid signal, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions include fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit in points, as well as closing counter-direction positions when opposite signals appear. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by loss-adjusted free margin, by loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk percentage or fixed lots, with MMMode determining the specific calculation method. The EA also includes a supplementary logic: when both opening and closing are allowed but no close signal exists, it searches backward through historical bars to find potential close-triggering signals.

EA-16214.name: Exp_BalanceOfPower_Histogram
EA-16214.summary: This EA trades based on the Balance of Power Histogram indicator, which measures the relative strength of buyers vs sellers. It opens buy positions when the histogram values rise consecutively and sell positions when they fall consecutively, with configurable money management and smoothing parameters.
EA-16214.summary_zh: 该EA基于Balance of Power Histogram指标进行交易，该指标衡量买卖双方的相对力量。当直方图值连续上升时开多仓，连续下降时开空仓，支持可配置的资金管理和平滑参数。
EA-16214.strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Balance of Power直方图指标，该指标通过比较高、低、开盘、收盘价来衡量市场中买方与卖方的力量对比。入场条件为：当直方图前一根值低于再前一根值（下降趋势），且当前值高于前一根值（反转上升）时，触发买入信号；反之，当直方图前一根值高于再前一根值（上升趋势），且当前值低于前一根值（反转下降）时，触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖固定止损和止盈点数，同时支持反向信号平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持多种保证金模式包括固定手数、余额百分比等。指标值经过可配置的平滑算法（T3、JJMA、VIDYA等）处理，减少噪声干扰。信号检测支持仅在新K线形成时触发或实时触发，取决于SignalBar参数设置。
EA-16214.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on the Balance of Power Histogram indicator, which measures the relative strength of buyers versus sellers by comparing high, low, open, and close prices. Entry conditions trigger a buy signal when the histogram's previous bar value is below the bar before that (downtrend) and the current bar value is above the previous bar (reversal upward); conversely, a sell signal triggers when the previous bar value exceeds the one before it (uptrend) and the current bar falls below the previous (reversal downward). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit in points, with additional support for closing positions on opposing signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the risk percentage, supporting multiple margin modes including fixed lot size, balance percentage, free margin percentage, and loss-adjusted variants. The indicator values are processed through a configurable smoothing algorithm (T3, JJMA, VIDYA, etc.) to reduce noise. Signal detection can operate either on new bar formation only or in real-time depending on the SignalBar parameter setting.

EA-16215.name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin
EA-16215.summary: This EA trades based on the i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin custom indicator, which applies spectral (Fourier) analysis to the Chaikin Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the spectrally-filtered Chaikin value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-16215.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin自定义指标进行交易，该指标对蔡金振荡器应用频谱（傅里叶）分析。当频谱滤波后的蔡金值向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并配有可配置的资金管理和止损/止盈水平。
EA-16215.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是对蔡金振荡器（Chaikin Oscillator）进行频谱分析滤波，通过傅里叶变换去除高频噪声，提取主要趋势方向。入场条件：当滤波后的指标值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>=Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当从上升转为下降（Value[0]<=Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件包括反向信号触发平仓以及止损/止盈触发平仓，多空平仓可独立开关控制。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除亏损后的自由保证金比例、按扣除亏损后的余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制比例或手数大小，默认为固定手数0.1手。策略使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线重复交易，并通过BarsCalculated确认指标数据就绪。
EA-16215.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy applies spectral (Fourier) analysis filtering to the Chaikin Oscillator, removing high-frequency noise via Fourier transform to extract the primary trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the filtered indicator value turns upward (Value[0]>=Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell position opens when it turns downward (Value[0]<=Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions include reverse signal-triggered closes and stop-loss/take-profit closes, with independent on/off switches for buy and sell closing. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for ratio or lot size, defaulting to a fixed 0.1 lot. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trades on the same bar and verifies indicator data readiness via BarsCalculated.

EA-16222.name: Exp_RVIDiff
EA-16222.summary: This EA trades based on the RVIDiff custom indicator, which applies a selectable smoothing algorithm to the Relative Vigor Index (RVI). It opens buy positions when the smoothed RVI is rising and sell positions when it is falling, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options.
EA-16222.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标RVIDiff进行交易，RVIDiff对相对活力指数(RVI)应用可选的平滑算法。当平滑RVI上升时开多仓，下降时开空仓，配有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-16222.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于RVIDiff指标，即对RVI（相对活力指数）进行二次平滑处理后的动量信号。入场条件为：当指标值从前一根bar到当前bar上升（Value[0]>=Value[1]）且整体呈下降趋势（Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓；当指标值下降（Value[0]<=Value[1]）且整体呈上升趋势（Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓，同时配合固定点数的止损和止盈进行风险管理。仓位管理支持五种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后的自由保证金比例、按亏损后的余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理参数MM控制下单手数或比例，默认0.1。策略默认在H6周期运行，使用T3平滑方法对RVI进行13周期的二次平滑处理。
EA-16222.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the RVIDiff indicator, which applies a secondary smoothing algorithm to the RVI (Relative Vigor Index) to generate momentum signals. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator value rises from the previous bar to the current bar (Value[0]>=Value[1]) and the overall trend was declining (Value[1]<Value[2]); a sell position is opened when the indicator value declines (Value[0]<=Value[1]) and the overall trend was rising (Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals for position closure, combined with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels for risk management. Position sizing supports five margin modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. The money management parameter MM controls the lot size or ratio with a default of 0.1. The strategy defaults to the H6 timeframe and uses the T3 smoothing method with a 13-period secondary smoothing of the RVI.

EA-16231.name: FibonacciRetracement
EA-16231.summary: This EA uses ZigZag indicator to identify swing highs and lows, then draws Fibonacci retracement levels on the most recent swing leg. It enters buy or sell trades when price crosses above a Fibo level in an uptrend or below a Fibo level in a downtrend, with fixed stop-loss and Fibonacci-based take-profit.
EA-16231.summary_zh: 该EA利用ZigZag指标识别摆动高低点，并在最近的摆动波段上绘制斐波那契回撤水平。当价格在上升趋势中突破斐波那契水平或在下降趋势中跌破斐波那契水平时，开仓买入或卖出，使用固定止损和基于斐波那契的止盈。
EA-16231.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于ZigZag指标识别的摆动高低点计算斐波那契回撤水平（23.6%、38.2%、61.8%、76.4%），并根据趋势方向在这些回撤水平附近寻找交易机会。入场条件为：在上升趋势中，当当前K线收盘价和前一根K线收盘价均突破某个斐波那契回撤水平并超过安全缓冲距离时做多；在下降趋势中，当价格跌破斐波那契水平时做空。出场条件包括固定点数的止损和基于斐波那契扩展倍数的止盈（TakeProfitAt参数控制）。仓位管理采用固定手数（TradeValue参数），没有动态仓位调整或资金管理逻辑。趋势判断通过比较最近四个ZigZag极值点的高低关系来确定，如果连续高点和低点都在抬升则为上升趋势，反之为下降趋势。此外，EA在平仓后会等待CloseBarPause根K线后才允许重新开仓，以避免频繁交易。
EA-16231.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is based on Fibonacci retracement levels (23.6%, 38.2%, 61.8%, 76.4%) calculated from swing highs and lows identified by the ZigZag indicator, seeking trading opportunities near these retracement levels based on trend direction. Entry conditions: in an uptrend, a buy is triggered when both the current bar close and the previous bar close cross above a Fibonacci retracement level by more than the SafetyBuffer distance; in a downtrend, a sell is triggered when price crosses below a Fibonacci level. Exit conditions include a fixed point-based stop-loss and a Fibonacci extension-based take-profit controlled by the TakeProfitAt parameter. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (TradeValue parameter) with no dynamic position adjustment or money management logic. Trend determination compares the most recent four ZigZag extremum points — if consecutive highs and lows are rising, it is an uptrend, and vice versa. Additionally, the EA enforces a CloseBarPause bar cooldown after a position is closed before allowing a new trade, avoiding over-trading.

EA-16245.name: Exp_STLMCandle
EA-16245.summary: This EA trades based on the STLMCandle custom indicator, which generates colored candle signals for trend direction. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-16245.summary_zh: 该EA基于STLMCandle自定义指标进行交易，该指标通过彩色K线信号判断趋势方向。当指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，并支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-16245.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用STLMCandle自定义指标作为核心信号源，该指标基于J线平滑算法（JJMA/VIDIA/AMA）生成趋势方向信号。入场条件为：当指标颜色缓冲区值从非2变为2时产生买入信号，从非0变为0时产生卖出信号，这代表趋势方向发生转变。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓（买入信号时平卖仓，卖出信号时平买仓），以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险敞口大小，默认使用固定手数0.1手。策略在每次新K线形成时重新计算信号，避免频繁交易，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统。
EA-16245.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the STLMCandle custom indicator as its core signal source, which generates trend direction signals based on J-line smoothing algorithms (JJMA/VIDIA/AMA). Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator color buffer value changes from non-2 to 2, and a sell signal is generated when it changes from non-0 to 0, representing a trend direction shift. Exit conditions include: closing positions on reverse signals (closing sell positions on buy signals and vice versa), plus fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by loss-adjusted free margin, by loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter which governs risk exposure size, defaulting to a fixed lot of 0.1. The strategy recalculates signals only on new bar formation to avoid overtrading, making it a typical trend-following system.

EA-16255.name: Exp_StochasticDiff
EA-16255.summary: This EA trades based on the StochasticDiff custom indicator, which applies an additional smoothing layer (T3 by default) on top of a standard Stochastic oscillator. It opens buy positions when the smoothed Stochastic value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
EA-16255.summary_zh: 该EA基于StochasticDiff自定义指标进行交易，该指标在标准随机振荡器之上叠加了额外的平滑层（默认T3）。当平滑后的随机值转向上时开多仓，转向下时开空仓，并在信号反转时可配置平仓。
EA-16255.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于StochasticDiff指标，该指标在传统Stochastic振荡器基础上增加了一层XMA平滑算法（默认T3），以过滤噪音信号。入场条件：当指标值前一周期低于前两周期（下降趋势）且当前值大于等于前一周期（拐头向上）时开多仓；当指标值前一周期高于前两周期（上升趋势）且当前值小于等于前一周期（拐头向下）时开空仓。出场条件：多仓在指标拐头向下时平仓，空仓在指标拐头向上时平仓，同时支持固定止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金比例、余额比例、亏损后余额比例或固定手数等多种模式。资金管理由TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供支持，但EA本身没有额外的风险控制层，如最大持仓限制或回撤保护。
EA-16255.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the StochasticDiff indicator, which adds an XMA smoothing algorithm (T3 by default) on top of a traditional Stochastic oscillator to filter noisy signals. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator value one bar ago is below the value two bars ago (downtrend) and the current value is greater than or equal to the previous bar (turning upward); a sell position opens when the reverse pattern occurs. Exit conditions: long positions close when the indicator turns downward, short positions close when it turns upward, with configurable fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted margin/balance, or fixed lot modes. Money management is supported by the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, but the EA itself lacks additional risk control layers such as maximum position limits or drawdown protection. The signal is evaluated on a configurable bar (SignalBar=1 by default, meaning the previous completed bar), and new bar detection prevents multiple entries per bar.

EA-12942.name: MD5 Cloud Decryptor
EA-12942.summary: MD5 Cloud Decryptor is a utility Expert Advisor that connects to cloud-based MD5 hash decryption services to resolve hash values. It does not execute any trading operations and serves purely as an informational/analytical tool within the MetaTrader 5 environment.
EA-12942.summary_zh: MD5 Cloud Decryptor是一个工具类EA，连接云端MD5哈希解密服务来解析哈希值。它不执行任何交易操作，纯粹作为MetaTrader 5环境中的信息/分析工具使用。
EA-12942.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略程序，而是一个工具类应用程序，主要功能是通过网络请求连接云端MD5解密数据库来破解或查询MD5哈希值。其不涉及任何入场条件或出场条件的设计，因为没有交易信号的生成逻辑。仓位管理和资金管理在此EA中完全不适用，因为它不会开仓或管理任何交易头寸。该工具的核心逻辑在于构造HTTP请求、发送哈希值到云端API、解析返回结果并展示给用户。整体设计思路偏向于网络通信与数据解析，与金融市场交易策略无关。
EA-12942.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy program but rather a utility application whose primary function is to connect to cloud-based MD5 decryption databases via network requests to crack or query MD5 hash values. It does not involve any entry or exit condition design since there is no trading signal generation logic. Position sizing and money management are completely inapplicable to this EA because it does not open or manage any trading positions. The core logic revolves around constructing HTTP requests, sending hash values to cloud APIs, parsing returned results, and displaying them to the user. The overall design approach is oriented toward network communication and data parsing, having no relation to financial market trading strategies.
